articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Bigdata Tools: Hadoop Vs Spark Vs Storm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Big data is expanding quickly in terms of volume, value, veracity, and velocity, making it challenging to process, acquire, and analyze the data. Big data analytics is becoming more and more well-liked as a technique for researching enormous amounts of data on demand. The Apache Hadoop, Apache Spark, and Apache Storm frameworks are three of the most popular large data processing frameworks. Despite the fact that all three of them allow large data processing, three frameworks have different uses and underlying architectures for those uses. Numerous studies have spent time and energy comparing different big data frameworks by assessing them for a specified key performance measure. Since a few years ago, Hadoop, Spark, and Storm frameworks have been developed and used for big data processing in this area. These platforms are producing encouraging outcomes. This study compares the Hadoop, Spark, and Storm frameworks and explores the development of big data computing platforms. When compared to the Apache Hadoop and Apache Storm frameworks, our research showed that Spark was superior in terms of processing time, CPU usage, latency, execution time and job performance.

articleTitle: Models and algorithms for determining the probability of occurrence of a critical combination of events for three-element minimum sections in intelligent decision support systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: A method for determining the probability of occurrence of a critical combination of events for the three-element minimum cross-sections of attributes of the characteristics of the software quality model of intelligent decision support systems is proposed.

articleTitle: The Computational Intelligence application for assessing the technical state of a multi-storey building damaged by an explosion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Since the accident risk and the technical state uncertainty degree of the object supporting frame are closely related concepts, the accident risk assessment should be carried out with an application a logical-probabilistic approach based on the probability theory theorems (hypothesis theorem, total probability theorem etc.), methods of fuzzy set theory, fuzzy logic techniques and methods of decision-making under uncertainty. To determine these values, the accident risk distribution law should be applied as an integral indicator for the building object structural safety level. To determine the structure reliability level based on its parameters deviations from the project as identified on an expertise basis, a rule based on the linguistic variable “very” is used. The detailed examination of the multi-storey building at 6A Lobanovskyi Avenue in Kyiv damaged by an explosion due to a missile hit was carried out using the fuzzy logic and linguistic variable “very” and allowed to establish that the building structures within the 18-26 storeys had the following main destructions and damage: the pylon in 2/I axes was completely destroyed and collapsed to a height of 18…21 storeys, the pylon surviving part at the level of 22…26 storeys hung without support etc. The calculations data indicated the need to strengthen the building damaged pylons. The building final technical state was assessed as the “4” emergency level in some areas of the 18-20 building storeys and as the “3” level of unsuitability for normal operation at the 17-27 building storeys level.

Author Keywords: a high-rise building damaged by an explosion

articleTitle: Information technologies for calculating the effect of wire thickness and insulation material on its heating temperature during operation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The paper evaluates the influence of wire thickness and insulation material on its heating temperature during operation. The temperature and time characteristics of wire exploitation under conditions of different load currents are analysed. The ranges of the wire temperature increase during operation are determined for wires with insulation made of polyethylene, polyvinyl chloride, enamel, and rubber.

Author Keywords: temperature and time characteristics of operation

articleTitle: An Approach to Blood Cell Classification Based on Object Segmentation and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The study proposed an approach to cells classification in a blood smear image, consisting of two stages: object segmentation and application of machine learning methods to determine the cell type. To apply this approach, a dataset consisting of cell type labels and the corresponding cell area was created. Object segmentation was performed using image processing methods: noise removal, image binarization, contouring, and area determination using the Gaussian formula. The obtained data set was pre-processed: duplicate data and outliers were removed, and the data was divided into testing and training sets. Training for Gaussian Naive Bayes Classifier, Decision Tree Classifier, Random Forest, Support Vector Classifier models were performed. It was found that the accuracy of all classifiers is 97-98%. In addition, metrics were calculated to evaluate the effectiveness of the models. The Decision Tree Classifier method was chosen to apply the approach to cell classification on new images. All image processing, data collection and processing, model training and evaluation were performed using the Python programming language and relevant libraries.

articleTitle: Identification of Disturbed Stabilization Systems based on Experimental Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The paper deals with the structural identification of complex dynamic systems. The identification experiment is described. The algorithm of the structural identification based on the analysis of experimental data is represented. The possibility of solving the identification problem with random controllable and uncontrollable disturbances is shown. The proposed identification problem is solved by the example of the aviation stabilization system. Graphical dependences of theoretical and experimental spectral densities of system outputs are represented.

articleTitle: Weierstrass Method of Analogue Signal Approximation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Recently, the problem of discrete signals approximation has become increasingly relevant. Despite the fact that there are many papers published on this and related topics, research in this area is still being actively conducted. However, in the case of analogue signals, the opposite situation can be observed. Since the interest in analogue signal processing is currently growing, it makes sense to solve problems similar to those of digital signal processing. One of such tasks is the problem of analogue signal approximation. The currently developed apparatus for approximation of digital signals allows developing and investigating similar methods for analogue signals. One of these methods is the use of various operators and the study of the quality of their approximation of signals of certain classes. In this paper, we study the peculiarities of approximation of analogue signals described by functions from the Sigmund class, the Weierstrass operators, which are poorly studied.

articleTitle: Military vehicles marking detection algorithm on a digital image
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Constant complicating of wars due to considerable development of military weapon and moving to new generation of warfare led to a significant change in means of it. More and more armed forces involve AI into solving a wide range of tasks, since modern war produces a lot of data which need to be processed and analyzed.In this work, an effective military vehicles marking detection algorithm was developed in order to make it possible to determine the ownership of military equipment based on its marking. It uses pure image processing algorithms instead of involving neural networks, like in R-CNN model or its derivatives. As a result, the algorithm does not require a huge dataset of marking templates and time for network training and can be applied immediately.The algorithm is not bound to a specific marking pattern and can be applied to any. Also it is designed for detecting military marking without reference to objects. As a result, the algorithm can be easily integrated with other image processing systems, e.g. military vehicles detection.

articleTitle: Creating Educational Products With Using Data Science and Digital Marketing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: It has been studied that the processes of digitalization and globalization have a positive effect on the development of the business environment at the national and international levels, especially through the involvement of advanced scientific achievements. Competition between market participants determines their leading role in identifying scientific achievements that can be commercialized by creating demand for products with new quality characteristics. It has been studied how information technologies are used in the creation of an educational platform, and the necessity of using digital marketing to promote innovative educational products among customers has been established. It has been proven that advanced marketing strategies contribute to the formation of high student loyalty to the educational platform. It was established that there are significant prospects for the use of IT product marketing by modern companies, which is explained by the need to promote modern software. The characteristics of representatives of generations Z and Alpha, who are the main consumers of educational services and determine the specific demand for modern educational products, were noted. It has been established that educational products with interactive technologies and the use of the Internet are of interest to representatives of generations Z and Alpha. It is substantiated that the use of machine learning algorithms and server technologies can optimize processes in education in modern conditions. The peculiarities of the integration of neural networks into the educational platform for improving the educational process and increasing the level of assimilation of skills and abilities by students have been revealed. It has been established that the use of comprehensive information about consumers of digital educational products contributes to the creation of a high level of loyalty and the attraction of new customers thanks to a positive image on the market. The expediency of using modern analytical tools actively used in Data Science to optimize key processes and monetize existing information arrays has been proven. It was determined that the combination of machine learning and digital marketing technologies can achieve optimal results in the promotion and commercialization of educational products.

articleTitle: Smart LPG Gas Detection and Automatic Booking System for Home Safety Using IoT Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) is routinely used by homeowners, but many are unaware of their daily usage rate and the framework of time in which they must schedule a refill. In homes and other places where residential gases are used, leakage creates a serious problem. So, we offer an Internet of Things (IoT)-based system that keeps track on number of LPG cylinder related variables and notifies the user via a mobile application. Here, using a sensor known as a load cell, the amount of gas present in the cylinder is detected. The amount of gas still in the cylinder is continuously updated in the user’s app, and the user is notified through the buzzer and the mobile app, respectively, when the gas level falls below the threshold value. Another safety feature included in this home automation system is to alert the user about the gas leak via a buzzer and a mobile application. Also, it deactivates the gas control knob to halt additional leaks at their source. Our mobile application can also be used to activate and deactivate the gas valve. This device can be used as an assistive mechanism for LPG gas leakage detection and automatic booking system for home safety purposes.

articleTitle: Specialized Schemes of Space-Vector Modulation of VSI for Synchronous Voltage Control of PV Stations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This paper briefly reviews the development and widespread use of an alternative method of synchronous pulse-width modulation (PWM), based on a space vector approach, for the control of voltage source inverters (VSIs) and inverter-based photovoltaic grid-tied (PV) installations with low switching frequency of inverters. It assures providing synchronization and symmetry of winding voltage of power transformer for any operation conditions including cases of fluctuation of grid frequency, of unequal voltages of dc-sources (PV panels), etc. Examples of the use of this PWM method to control several topologies of VSI-based photovoltaic stations with multi-winding power transformer are presented.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of electric drives for the seed hulling mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: A comparative analysis of various AC electric drive systems for a scourge seed breaker has been carried out, which makes it possible to meet the specified requirements of the seed breaker technological process at minimal cost.

articleTitle: Electric Field and Current Density in the Insulation of High Voltage Cables Taking Into Account its Nonlinear Properties
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The features of electric field disturbance and current density increasing in cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) insulation of high voltage power cables were studied with taking into account the presence of water microinclusions and water trees in such insulation during operation. Also, there were taking into account nonlinear insulation properties, in particular increase in a specific electrical conductivity in local areas of the dielectric with the highest strength of the electric field. The paper defines the patterns of change in the magnitude of the electric field stress and total current density in the XLPE insulation near water microdefects and the additional impact on such patterns the electrical conductivity dependence of field strength in local volumes. It is indicated that such electrophysical effects on polymer insulation led to an increase in the density of the leakage current, losses, local overheating and destruction of the insulation and should be taking into account.

articleTitle: Study of the Influence of Rolling Modes on the Operation of Interconnected Electric Drives of a Rolling Mill
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The paper is devoted to study of the influence of rolling modes on the performance of powerful interconnected electric drives of a hot rolling mill under the action of an electromagnetic coupling circuit between the electric drives of the roughing and finishing groups. The action of the electromagnetic coupling circuit manifests itself in the form of the influence of impact loads of synchronous electric drives on the angular velocity of direct current electric drives of the finishing group of the mill. The parameters of the electromagnetic coupling circuit are determined by the power supply scheme and equipment parameters. Values of impact loads applied to a synchronous motor depend on the rolling process parameters, in particular, the chemical composition of the rolled steel and the temperature of the ingot. The paper presents the results of calculating the rolling power for various rolling mode parameters. Using mathematical modeling in Simulink, numerical estimates of the influence of rolling modes on the magnitude of the voltage drop in the power supply unit and the drop in the angular velocity of the electric drive of the finishing group were obtained on the example of a wide-strip hot rolling mill 1700 of ArcelorMittal Temirtau JSC.

articleTitle: Physical Processes of Aging and Assessment of the Technical Condition of Power Cables with Paper-Impregnated Insulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Generalized theoretical and experimental diagnostic studies of power cables with paper-impregnated insulation of NPP cables according to mechanical and electrical characteristics are given. Understanding the complex synergistic mechanisms of aging of power cables made it possible to estimate the degree of aging of solid paper-impregnated insulation based on the determination of its individual parameters. Laboratory studies have proven the difference in the mechanical and electrical properties of phase and tape insulation in the process of thermal aging of power cables. The use of the number of double folds as a highly sensitive parameter for assessing the technical condition of paper insulation is substantiated. Criteria for the limit state of paper insulation according to mechanical characteristics have been established. The effectiveness of determining the individual values of the electrical parameters of phase and strip insulation based on the results of the tangent of the dielectric loss angle of power cables has been proven. For nuclear power plant cables, it was established that the difference tg$\delta$ of phase and belt insulation at a frequency of 10 kHz exceeds 5 times and can be considered as a sign of reaching the critical condition of the cable during long-term operation. For power cables of electrical networks, a negative correlation was established between the tangent of the dielectric loss angle of the paper insulation for a frequency of 50 Hz and the number of double bends. The critical values of the tangent of the dielectric loss angle of the phase and tape, which correspond to the limit value of the number of double bends of the cable paper of the power cables operating at a frequency of 50 Hz, have been determined.

articleTitle: Applying a Series-Resonant Inverter with Extended Topology for Load Impedance Matching in Dual-Frequency Induction Heating Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This article proposes the use of a series-resonant inverter with extended topology for load impedance matching in dual-frequency induction heating systems. The mathematical analysis shows that the use of the inverter makes it possible to change the primary winding voltage of the matching transformer, and in such a way match the load impedance of the series-resonant circuit at the different influencing frequencies. The simulation results confirm the feasibility of such an approach.

articleTitle: Improving the Accuracy of Motion Sensing by Three-Probe Microwave Interferometry
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This paper presents a three-probe displacement measurement technique with account for the antenna reflection coefficient and the actual interprobe distances. The problem of unambiguous displacement determination is reduced to choosing the proper root of the biquadratic equation in the unknown magnitude of the target reflection coefficient. It is shown that ignoring the antenna reflection coefficient and the variations of the interprobe distances from their setting values may introduce a sizeable error.

articleTitle: Phased Modeling Of An Autonomous Solar Power Plant And Its Operation In The Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This research presents the stages of modeling an autonomous solar power plant to study its operating modes. The evaluation is performed using a simple analytical method for extracting the parameters included in the equation for the behavior of the photovoltaic module. A mathematical representation of a solar cell (PV) is showcased utilizing the Matlab-Simulink platform to determine the variables of a nonlinear equation that correlates the current (I) with the voltage (V) equation. Employing a straightforward and effective approach to assess series resistance, ideality ratio, maximum power point tracking (MPPT) control, saturation current, and shunt conductance in illuminated solar cells. Furthermore, this document explores the creation of a DC-DC buck converter and the incorporation of a DC-DC buck converter with a PV module. DC/AC buck converter modeled using Matlab. The input and output information of the converter are derived from simulation under open-loop conditions with a consistent DC input voltage. In addition, outputs are taken from the converter, feeding the output of the photovoltaic module as an input to it.

articleTitle: Study of Methods for Improving the Meta-Algorithm of the Bagging Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: In this paper, we explored approaches that improve the performance of ensemble bagging classifiers for identifying the state of a computer system. The following algorithms are considered: Ensemble pruning, Advanced Voting Algorithms, Dynamic Voting Strategies, Confidence Calibration, Adaptation through Meta-Features and Meta-Learning, which allow improving the voting procedure of the bagging meta-algorithm. Artificial data was generated as initial data, which complicates the classification task and contains an increased amount of noise. In the Google Collab environment, software models of algorithms have been developed, and their quality has been assessed. It was found that the use of the Ensemble pruning and Adaptation through Meta-Features algorithm is the most qualitative. In addition, the Ensemble pruning algorithm reduces the number of basic ensemble classifiers, and, as a result, increases the efficiency of computer system identification. Based on the results of the study, a method for identifying a computer system was proposed through the integrated use of a bagging classifier and an optimization procedure based on the Ensemble pruning algorithm.

articleTitle: The Statistical Characteristics Analysis of the Transport Conveyor Input Material Flow
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This paper is devoted to the research of the statistical characteristics of a non-stationary material flow incoming the input of a transport conveyor. A technique for analysing the statistical characteristics of the input material flow was developed, which is based on the representation of the material flow as a superposition of the values of a deterministic and stochastic ergodic process. Dimensionless parameters are introduced that characterize the input material flow, which can be used to determine the similarity criteria for the transport conveyor input material flow. The method for calculating the statistical characteristics of a random input material flow is based on the implementation of a random process obtained as a result of experimental measurements of the input material flow. For the synthesis of the values of the deterministic and stochastic process, a quality criterion based on the theoretical correlation function was used. The calculation of statistical characteristics was carried out by the method of successive approximations.

articleTitle: Synthesis of a Control System of a Pulse Converter for Plasmatron Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The technique of synthesis by the method of localizing the control system of the impulse DC voltage converter is justified here. Linearized averaged structural and circuit models of the model of the power part of the converter were used and a synthesis example is given. The main properties of the resulting system show the results of numerical modeling.

articleTitle: Forest Recovery Detection Based on U-Net and LinkNet
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Nowadays geographical information systems (GIS) software may be a huge problem for people, who want to learn the art of forestry. Not every such product offers tools for analysis with the help of artificial intelligence. The market of forestry software growth each year and researches in the field are out of human capabilities to grasp. However, despite all of that, there are not so much researches on topic of “reforestation” with the usage of machine learning techniques. The purpose of the work is to implement the system of reforestation and deforestation detection system as part of developing an accounting application for forestry. Totally two segmentation neural network architectures and three different encoders were used, in order to create a comparison characteristic of networks for the problem. Tests show high accuracy results (at least 94%) on each network in the project. Moreover, best neural network accuracy performance is 97.45%.

articleTitle: The Efficiency of Combined Control of Flow Parameters of a Transport Conveyor Using Energy Management Methodology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the synthesis of optimal controls of flow parameters for a transport conveyor with input and output accumulating bunkers. The possibility of reducing the unit costs for material transportation, based on the use of energy management methodology, is considered. For the optimal control synthesis, an analytical PiKh-model of the transport conveyor is used, taking into account the transport delay and restrictions on the maximum allowable material density. A control quality criterion is written that characterizes the cost of material transportation between the input and output accumulating bunkers. The Lagrange function is determined for the model of the transport conveyor with restrictions on the maximum and minimum amount of material in the accumulating bunkers. An analysis of the effectiveness of using the energy management methodology in the combined control of the transport conveyor flow parameters was carried out. It is shown that for the effective use of the energy management methodology, large-capacity bunkers are required.

articleTitle: Complex Frequencies Eigenvalue Problem of Laser Based on Quantum Wire with Two Graphene Strips
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The H-polarized modes of the laser, which consists of a circular cylindrical quantum wire and two graphene strips inside it are considered. The active material of the wire has complex-valued refractive index. We seek the pairs of the frequency and material gain which satisfy the threshold conditions. To solve the corresponding boundary-value problem we use the method of integral equations.

articleTitle: Silicon p-i-n Photodiode with Reduced Background Radiation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The article examines the possibility of minimizing the influence of background radiation on the useful signal of silicon four-element p-i-n photodiodes. When examining the sources, it was established that optical filters are an effective means of avoiding noise of optical origin. A number of variants of optical filters were analyzed, and it was established that the optimal material for making filters is silicon, because it has its own absorption edge at a wavelength of about 1000 nm. To reduce the reflection coefficient, an anti-reflective coating was formed on the surface of the silicon filters. It was established that with an increase in the thickness of the filter, the transmission coefficient decreases due to a decrease in the radiation intensity during propagation in the absorbing medium. It is seen that when the thickness of the filter changes, its absorption edge shifts toward shorter wavelengths. the obtained optical filters allow to effectively avoid the influence of background radiation on the useful signal of the photodiode. The disadvantage of the proposed filters is an increase in the absorption coefficient when the thickness of the samples increases. The optimal thickness is 170$\mu$ m, but this thickness contributes to some deviation from the maximum of the spectral characteristic.

articleTitle: Possibilities and Challenges of Partially Using a Charge-Discharge Cycle of Battery to Increase Its Resource
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The work investigates the effect of limiting the depth of discharge of a rechargeable battery on its lifespan. The average daily mileage of electric vehicles in Ukraine and other countries was analyzed and found to be significantly less than the driving range of any serial electric vehicle. The results showed that limiting the depth of discharge by 50% can increase the battery’s lifespan by approximately 20%. Ways of modernizing power converters that control the charging and discharging processes of an electric vehicle were considered with the aim of increasing the rechargeable battery’s lifespan without imposing restrictions on the user.

articleTitle: A Distribution-free Method of Condition Deterioration Detection for Radio Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Due to the action of various external and internal factors, the technical condition of radio equipment usually deteriorates over time, especially at long observation intervals. Such factors include, in particular, changes in the supply voltage, environmental conditions, the presence of vibrations and noise, etc. Due to the occurrence of deterioration, the number of failures and faults increases, and therefore the time between failures decreases. During the normal operation of the equipment, the exponential model of time between failures is usually used. However, during deterioration, this model changes to a more complex one, and information about the type of this model is not known priori. Therefore, this paper is devoted to the development of a distribution-free method for detecting the deterioration of the technical condition of radio equipment. The synthesis of the detection method is based on the Kruskal-Wallis approach. The analysis of the efficiency of the detection method is performed based on the statistical simulation.

articleTitle: Assessment of Electric Loads Maneuvering Capabilities Using by Industrial Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The continuous growth of renewable energy sources in the integrated energy system and the discrepancy between declared and actual electricity consumption result in significant differences between the hourly volumes of electricity sales and purchases on the day-ahead market. Resolving these differences, known as imbalances, requires additional financial costs on industrial enterprises. This article explores the potential usage of consumer-regulators to maneuver the electric load of an industrial enterprise, aiming to mitigate electricity imbalances and reduce the overall cost of daily electricity consumption.

articleTitle: Using Solar Energy in Eco-Project Based Learning for Sustainability
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The article deals with using solar energy in Eco-Project Based Learning for sustainability, aligning with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. This approach combines problem-solving with environmental and sustainable issues. The methodology of Eco-Project Based Learning for enhancing student creativity has been improved and adapted. In this eco-context, students investigate the application of renewable energy on the example of solar generation and sustainable resource management. The study analyzes the potential of applying solar energy in Ukraine and implementing the results of Eco-Project Based Learning in the educational process.

articleTitle: Impact of DC Magnetron Sputtering Modes on the Crystalline Size and Intrinsic Strain of CdS Thin Films
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This study investigates the properties of CdS thin films, obtained by DC magnetron sputtering, specifically focusing on their elastic properties and structural parameters. The analysis of the XRD patterns indicates a uniform thickness for the hexagonal crystal structure CdS layers. The average crystallite size of the CdS nanostructured thin films is estimated to be 28 nm using the Scherrer equation. The lattice strain is calculated for FTO/CdS sample using the Williamson-Hall equation and the uniform deformation model. The uniform deformation model analysis suggests an average strain of $4.04 \times 10^{-3}$. The strain analysis using the modified Williamson-Hall equation and the size-strain plot method yields consistent results. The average strain obtained from the Williamson-Hall plot is $0.92 \times 10^{-3}$, while the size-strain plot method gives a particle size of 67 nm. The different analysis methods employed in the study exhibit good consistency and correlation.

articleTitle: Heat map of a simple indoor transformer model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The investigation focused on designing a natural ventilation system for the primary transformer enclosure within an indoor substation. Various air distribution plans were developed by adjusting the dimensions and placement of air inlets and outlets. To evaluate these schemes, a comprehensive three-dimensional airflow simulation was carried out using the Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) approach, specifically utilizing the FLUENT software to simulate the ventilation and cooling effects of various indoor ventilation schemes. The velocity fields and temperature fields were analyzed to compare and examine The impact of various design parameters on the safety and dependability of the primary transformer enclosure within the indoor substation.

articleTitle: A Novel Reduced Current Amplitude Fluctuation PDM Control Strategy for Modular-Structured Series-Resonant Converters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This paper presents a novel reduced current amplitude fluctuation pulse-denisty modulation (PDM) control strategy for modular-structured series-resonant converters by combining the advantages of interleaved PDM, stepped PDM, and augmented PDM principles. The proposed strategy aims to mitigate the disadvantages of existing PDM methods. By introducing step-by-step changes in the pulse density in each channel of the converter while preserving the interleaving principle, the proposed strategy ensures more uniform power losses and lower fluctuations in the output current amplitude. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed strategy in reducing current amplitude fluctuations.

articleTitle: 2-DOF Robot Optimal Control via Artificial Neural Network Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: In the study optimal control problem a 2-DOF robot is stated. Criterion, which must be minimized, reflected RMS of drives power and length of the load trajectory in the “x- y” plane. The problem was reduced to the minimization of a complex cost function, which includes an artificial neural network (ANN) component. To train ANN reinforcement learning procedure was carried out, where punishment is associated with the cost function value. All the obtained results were analyzed via plots of the robot links motion and trajectory of the load.

articleTitle: Design And Researching Smart Biologically Active Polymeric Hydrogel Transdermal Nanomaterial’s
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: In this article, effective 3D printing technology of smart biologically active polymeric hydrogel transdermal nanomaterial’s based on gelatin and sodium alginate, modified by humic acids, were researched. It is shown that the application of new smart biologically active polymeric hydrogel transdermal nanomaterial’s based gelatin and sodium alginate modified by humic acids allows improving the skin moisture - lipid balance. Smart biologically active polymeric hydrogel transdermal nanomaterial’s patches were produced using a micromolding technique where an FDM 3D printer was used to print the master mold. Form modeling was done in Autodesk’s Fusion 360. The resulting 3D model was processed by a slicer to receive a file with commands for a 3D printer. So, designed 3D printing technology of smart biologically active polymeric hydrogel transdermal nanomaterial’s based on gelatin, sodium alginate, modified by humic acids, are transdermal materials with good properties.

articleTitle: Truncated Sequential Procedure of Statistical Data Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The transition to Industry 4.0 involves the implementation of modern information technologies. This framework uses the doctrine of data-driven decision-making. The implementation of this doctrine includes the collecting, processing, and use of data for the formation and implementation of control influences in the relevant systems of the industry. During processing, two basic approaches are possible: based on a fixed sample size and with a random sample size within the framework of A. Wald’s sequential analysis. This paper is devoted to the synthesis and analysis of a truncated sequential statistical classification procedure with the arrangement of two decision thresholds according to Bellman’s approach.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Smart Grid Power Supply System of Radio Engineering Complex of Ionosphere Institute
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The article is devoted to the development and improvement of methods for controlling the power supply of high-capacity facilities with high consumption, which use Smart Grid technology. A task system has been established to develop general approaches and methods for modernizing operating complexes of radio electronic equipment, as well as synthesizing new power supply systems using Smart Grid technologies. The calculation of the energy storage required to compensate for the operation of the radio transmitter has been performed. A method for modernizing the power system of radio engineering research complexes, based on research conducted at the Ionosphere Institute, has been presented. The power supply control system has been synthesized.

articleTitle: A Generalized Approach to Deduce the Wave Parameters of High-Voltage Single-Core Power Cables
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The characteristics of power high-voltage cables differ from the characteristics of ordinary overhead lines. When wind or solar power plants are connected to high-voltage power cables with cross-linked polyethylene insulation, the electrical capacity of which is greater compared to the capacity of an equivalent overhead line, resonant a wide frequencies range arise. This causes a change in the active resistance and inductance of the current-conducting core and the cable as a whole and leads to a change in the wave parameters of power cables with polymer insulation in a wide frequency range. A generalized method of determining the wave parameters of single-core high-voltage power cables based on the determination of active resistance, inductance, capacitance, and active insulation conductivity in a wide frequency range is presented. The methodology is based on the numerical calculation of active resistance and inductance, taking into account the skin effect and the effect of the proximity of the magnetically connected circuits of the conductive core and the metal screen of the power cable. The electric capacity, the tangent of the dielectric loss angle and the active conductivity of the three-layer composite system are determined taking into account the thickness and frequency dependences of the electrophysical parameters of the semiconductor screens. It has been proven that wave resistance is an individual characteristic of power cables and is determined by the cross-section of the current-conducting core, the electro-physical properties of the three-layer electrical insulation system, and the thickness of their components. The influence in the high-frequency range of the tangent of the dielectric loss angle on the attenuation coefficient of electromagnetic energy in power cables of the voltage class of 110 kV is shown. Emphasis is placed on the need to create a database of electro-physical characteristics and thickness of semiconductor screens of power cables from manufacturers. The proposed method has important practical significance in determining the wave parameters of power cables at the stage of manufacture and operation.

articleTitle: Advantages of Fog Computing: A Comparative Analysis with Cloud Computing for Enhanced Edge Computing Capabilities
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Fog computing extends the capabilities of cloud computing by enabling computing at the edge of the network, involving devices such as mobile collaborative devices or fixed nodes with integrated storage, computing, and communication capabilities. Fog computing offers benefits such as improved efficiency, increased security, savings in network bandwidth, and increased flexibility. In order to provide a complete understanding of Fog computing, this paper presents its salient features and highlights the differences from cloud computing research. Cloud computing is an emerging technology that offers computing resources on a pay-per-use basis. It provides three service models, and the cloud offers cost-effective centrally managed resources for reliable computing for specific tasks. This document presents a comparison between Fog computing and cloud computing, highlighting the differences in design, deployment, services, and tools available to organizations and users. By explicating the distinctiveness of fog computing and its contrast to cloud computing, we contribute to the field by shedding light on the unparalleled potential of fog computing in conserving resources while delivering robust computational solutions at the network periphery. Our study offers a new perspective that challenges the prevailing practices and extends the discourse on optimizing distributed computing architectures.

articleTitle: Determination of the spatial harmonic composition of the electromagnetic field during non-destructive testing of cylindrical products
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This report discusses the application of electromagnetic methods for non-destructive testing of cylindrical ferromagnetic products. The electromagnetic method is known for its high sensitivity to electrical parameters such as magnetic permeability and electrical conductivity, allowing for material identification and detection of structural changes or defects. The report focuses on solving the inverse problem by analyzing the field distribution on the circumference of measuring coils and studying field changes based on the object’s parameters. The spatial-periodic structure of the field is analyzed and the series of spatial harmonics is obtained using cosine series approximation. The analysis reveals the dominant harmonics and approximates the distribution function with an exponential function. The results demonstrate the accuracy of the approximation and highlight the discrepancies between the original and approximated functions, suggesting the possibility of reducing errors through further refinements.

articleTitle: Synthesis of CdO/por-CdS/CdS Heterostructure with Doughnut-Like Crystallites
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The CdO/por-CdS/CdS heterostructures were formed by a three-step electrochemical treatment method, which included cathodic etching, anodic deposition, and simple chemical etching. As a result, a porous layer of por-CdS was synthesized on the surface of CdS, onto which a layer of CdO was deposited. An interesting outcome of the research is the formation of doughnut-shaped CdO crystallites. These crystallites demonstrate a large effective surface area and may be applied as magnetic or photocatalytic materials. A mechanism for the formation of doughnut-like crystallites is proposed. EDX and RAMAN analysis confirmed the presence of CdO on the surface in both crystalline and amorphous states.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Normal Modes of Oscillating Nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Single walled nanotube, which is described by the geometrical nonlinear Sanders-Koiter shell theory, is considered. The free nonlinear oscillations of the nanoshell are described by the system of nonlinear partial differential equations. These equations are reduced to the nonlinear system of the ordinary differential equations. The concept of nonlinear normal modes is used to study the free nonlinear oscillations. Three approaches (harmonic balance method, Shaw-Pierre concept and shooting technique) are used to analyze nonlinear normal modes of nanotubes. These three approaches are used to analyze the backbone curves of nonlinear normal modes. The Naimark-Sacker bifurcations are observed on this curve. As a result of this bifurcation, the quasi-periodic motions are observed.

articleTitle: Approach to the Industrial Automation Systems Design, Taking into Account the Properties of Electric Drives
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The purpose of the study was to extend the previously created methodology for designing electromechanical systems to design of manufacturing process control systems. This methodology is based on SysML language, conceptual graphs and artificial intelligence software tool CoGui. It involves the construction of an information model of design project that contains knowledge about the requirements for the system being designed and a knowledge base of available technical solutions. Redundant information model of possible solutions and the constraints set by the designer is used for transformation design knowledge models to final design solutions. The methodology is verified by evaluating the degree of consistency and feasibility of design solutions for typical examples of industrial automation systems.

articleTitle: Nonlinear dynamics of electrical generator with diesel engine gear
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The method for calculations of resonance nonlinear torsional vibrations in power plant of diesel engine is suggested. The power plant optimization are performed. The nonlinear torsional oscillations of the generating plant, which consists of diesel engine 3TD-4 and traction alternator, is analyzed. The power plant diesel engine is optimized according to oscillations characteristics. As follows from the results of the calculations, the resonances of the torsion vibrations are observed in the wide frequency ranges of the engine operation. Therefore, the resonance vibrations must be tuning out by using optimization theory

articleTitle: Methods for Improving the Quality of Classification on Imbalanced Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The subject of the study is methods of balancing raw data. The purpose of the article is to improve the quality of intrusion detection in computer networks by using class balancing methods. Task: to investigate methods of balancing classes and to develop a classification method on imbalanced data to increase the level of network security. The methods used are: methods of artificial intelligence, machine learning. The following results were obtained: Class balancing methods based on Undersampling, Oversampling and their combinations were studied. The following methods were chosen for further research: SMOTEENN, SVMSMOTE, BorderlineSMOTE, ADASYN, SMOTE, KMeansSMOTE. The UNSW-NB 15 set was used as the source data, which contains information about the normal functioning of the network and during intrusions. A decision tree based on the CART (Classification And Regression Tree) algorithm was used as the basic classifier. According to the research results, it was found that the use of the SMOTEENN method provides an opportunity to improve the quality of detection of intrusions in the functioning of the network. Conclusions. The scientific novelty of the obtained results lies in the complex use of data balancing methods and the method of data classification based on decision trees to detect intrusions into computer networks, which made it possible to reduce the number of Type II errors.

articleTitle: Algorithmic support of the automatic identification device for industrial units nodes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The article is devoted to the issues of creating an analytical justification for the designing of hardware, algorithmic and software devices for automatic identification of the structure and parameters of the mathematical model of industrial units nodes in order to determine on-line parameters P, PI, PD, PID controllers, for optimal control of technological processes of such units. The article presents the type of equipment, considers and analyzes the main aspects of the theoretical regulation of technical parameters, evaluates and selects the basic method of practical identification, builds an algorithm for the operation of an automatic identification device, implements an automatic identification device of industrial units nodes by means of a graphical programming environment LabView for simulation modeling.

articleTitle: Prediction of optimal operating point for BPG-based lossy compression of images corrupted by Poisson noise
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Lossy image compression becomes a standard way to solve the problem of the rapidly increasing image size that is faced due to better quality of sensors and spatial resolution. Compression of noise-free images is mostly considered. However, images are often corrupted by noise and this property needs to be taken into account in solving the problem of efficient lossy compression. One of the peculiarities of lossy compression of noisy images is the filtering effect that often leads to existence of the so-called optimal operation point (OOP) for which a compressed image in sense of quality is closer to noise free compared to the noisy image. OOP existence can be predicted for some simple noise models such as Gaussian noise for greyscale and color images. Here our study deals with OOP prediction for images corrupted by Poisson noise compressed by Better Portable Graphics (BPG) coder. We demonstrate the possibility of OOP prediction for such metrics as PSNR and PSNR-HVS-M and verify the proposed approach performance using images that have not been used in the preliminary “training”. In addition, the formula for the OOP position determination is presented.

articleTitle: Secondary Piezoresonance Transducer for Diagnostic Spirometer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The presented work is devoted to the development of a secondary measuring transducer for a portable spirometer based on the use of a piezoresonator with a gap. A 3D model of the Venturi flowmeter was created using SolidWorks CAD software, followed by static and dynamic studies. The simulation results made it possible to determine the radial displacement range of the measuring bands at maximum and minimum inlet flow rates. Families of control characteristics for a measuring transducer with inter-electrode gap modulation (MTIGM) using different combinations of measuring band thicknesses were constructed. It is found that by selecting optimum measuring band thicknesses it is possible to achieve the desired linearity of the control characteristics for a secondary measuring transducer.

articleTitle: Recycling innovation in European circular networks: the case of multinational electrical manufacturing companies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The circular economy (CE) concept is gaining prominence in addressing the global sustainability crisis. Multinational electrical manufacturing companies (MNEMCs) play a crucial role in the transition to a CE but face challenges in implementing circular practices. Engagement in circular ecosystems offers opportunities for resource access, knowledge sharing, and collaboration. This study investigates the participation of MNEMCs in European circular networks that are non-profit organizations and focus on recycling innovation. By fitting a regression tree, this study analyzes MNEMCs’ commitment to circular transformation based on their environmental, social, and governance (ESG) rankings. By examining MNEMCs’ involvement in European circular networks, it also explores the implications for recycling innovation within the sector. The findings contribute to understanding the dynamics of recycling innovation in the context of MNEMCs operating within European circular networks.

articleTitle: Ant Algorithm with an Adaptive Step
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The article considers the possibilities of increasing the efficiency of the adapted ant algorithm thanks to the application of algorithms of the variable step of robots. It is shown that the main drawback that slows down the work of the adapted ant algorithm is the repeated checking of cells that are close to the base of the swarm. With the help of computer simulations, it was proved that the most effective method of increasing the efficiency of the original adapted ant algorithm is the application of the ant algorithm with an adaptive robot step, which allows the robots to quickly leave the segment around the base containing a large number of repeatedly checked cells.

articleTitle: The research of the elevator electromechanical system in terms of reducing the arising dynamic loads
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The electromechanical model of an elevator is developed in the article. The electromechanical model of an elevator is based on a three-mass system, which takes into account the most considerable resilient connections between the moving masses. It makes possible to evaluate the oscillations, which are related with considerable oscillations in electromagnetic torque during direct start of the asynchronous motor by the power supply. Using a model, which are created in the Matlab Simulink software the transitional processes of the operation, the forces and the moments elevator have been researched by using such operation modes as lifting and lowering a loaded and empty cabin. The negative impact of significant fluctuations in resilient moments, which are several times higher than the nominal ones is determined. The important aspect of the research is the using of a two-speed AC motor in the model. This gives reason to the implement of the non-standard method of eliminating oscillations by starting the motor first at a reduced speed, by connecting a low-speed multi-pole winding, and then by switching to a high-speed winding and moving the elevator to a specified floor. The proposed method reduces the resilient moment oscillations by half, which is a useful result for practical applications in the elevator’s facilities.

articleTitle: Planar Waveguide Defect Features for Photon- Magnon Coupling Strength Increasing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The numerical simulation of the electromagnetic properties of the planar waveguide defect was made. Hereof, transmission coefficient spectra were obtained as the function of the external magnetic field for the planar waveguide defect with the YIG film. From these spectra, both parameters of the collective coupling strength $g/(2\pi)$ and spin-numbernormalized photon-magnon coupling strength $g_{N}$ were received. The parameters of the planar waveguide were determined for which the value of the spin-number-normalized photon-magnon coupling strength has reached $10.3\mathrm{~Hz}$ at the frequency of 5.0GHz. It was shown that the additional use of a lumped element in the form of a capacitance makes it possible to significantly reduce the resonator length by a factor of 5.

articleTitle: A Mathematical Model of a Multicopter with a Hybrid Power System at a Takeoff
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This paper discusses a model of a multicopter with a hybrid power system as an alternative to installations with energy sources exclusively based on electrochemical batteries as the main onboard power source. When using batteries, the flight time is usually limited to 10-20 minutes. The main results of the preliminary analysis and modeling of the working processes of the subsystems of the hybrid power system are presented. Subsystems include an internal combustion engine, a permanent magnet alternator and voltage rectification module, electric motors with propellers, and control systems. The model of a sequential hybrid power system is analyzed at the stage of takeoff of a multicopter. To simulate the electrical machines of a hybrid power system, analytical and numerical calculation methods were used, which made it possible to determine the inductance and phase flux linkage for the generator and electric motors of the multicopter. The developed multicopter dynamics model with restrictions on many parameters made it possible to evaluate the takeoff process to a given height of 10 m. The model showed a decrease in the frequency of rotation of the generator drive motor and a decrease in the supply voltage of onboard consumers. From the simulation results of the presented electrical architecture, it becomes necessary to add a battery to its power branch. The main task of the battery is to stabilize the voltage of onboard consumers in case of a sharp change in the energy balance of power, as well as to perform an emergency landing.

articleTitle: The calculation of the Sectionalizer location in Medium Voltage Distribution Systems to reduction the Expected Energy Not-Supplied to consumer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: An approach is proposed that allows you to quickly and accurately calculate the optimal location for installing a sectionalizing device in power distribution networks with a tree structure. This approach is adopted to medium voltage distribution network with one power source and one main vacuum circuit breaker. Also are analyzed systems that can automatically switch the load to an alternate external grid and have secondary circuit breaker that is normal off. The objective function for calculating the sectionalizer location is to reduce value of the expected energy not-supplied to the consumers in a case installation one sectionalizer. The results of solving objective function are summarized in tabular forms. This result is easy to use during approximate calculations. To improve accuracy, an algorithm for solving a discrete problem is proposed, which uses an approximate result obtained in a tabular manner to reduce the complexity of calculations.

articleTitle: Experimental Research of Induction Short Circuit Current Limiting Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: In the article the induction short circuit current limiting method of solving a problem of fault current is considered. The constructive scheme of induction short circuit current limiter with a movable electromagnet armature is considered. The peculiarities of operating of such device at occurrence of short circuit are considered. The mathematic model of induction short circuit current limiter with magnetic circuit is carried out. To take into account the nonlinear properties of the volt-ampere characteristic when using a ferromagnetic core, which is related to the magnetization curve of steel, an experimental research of magnetization is proposed. In addition, with the air gap application, the magnetic system of the current limiter has a variable in a certain range magnetic reluctance, which can affect on the reactance of the winding accordingly. Correlating with the experimental data, mathematical reproduction of the magnetic system in the mathematical package Finite Element Method Magnetics is offered for the analysis of the magnetic field with certain assumptions, and, accordingly, the volt-ampere characteristics and traction forces.

articleTitle: Multiphase Isolated DC-DC Converter With Combined Magnetic Elements
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: When designing multiphase DC-DC converters, due to the increase in the number of magnetic elements with an increase in the number of switching phases, the weight and size indicator of the product as a whole becomes relevant. The topology of a multi-phase DC-DC boost converter with a reduced number of magnetic elements is proposed by combining an input storage inductor and a transformer in one structural element. Possible combinations of states are investigated on the example of a 3-phase converter and the preservation of the positive qualities of multi-phase converters is shown. Theoretical calculations of the overall power of magnetic elements have been carried out, which show a decrease in the weight and size index of magnetic elements relative to the classical 3-phase converter. With a fixed value of the supply voltage, the decrease in the weight and size indicator is 34.8%, and with a twofold change, the indicator increases to 43.5%. The practical implementation of the proposed topology of a 3-phase converter showed a decrease in the weight and size index of magnetic elements by 33%.

articleTitle: Overview Of Modern Augmented Reality Capabilities For Creating A Navigation Aid For The Blind
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This paper discusses the hardware requirements, prospects, and possibilities of using the ARCore, library to work with augmented reality in order to create a portable navigation assistant for the blind. Examples of the obtained depth map from street frames are evaluated.

articleTitle: Method of Selection of Programmable Logic Controller in Conditions of Fuzzy Information
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The paper analyzes the problem of selecting programmable logic controllers. The features of PLC evaluation for automation of various objects are revealed. The expediency of using the method of fuzzy multicriteria analysis when choosing the best PLC for the automation of industrial facilities is substantiated. The use of paired comparisons of PLC alternatives makes the application of the method convenient for developers. A feature of the method is the use of the Bellman-Zade principle. The PLC that simultaneously satisfies all the specified criteria to the maximum extent is selected as a solution. A method for selecting a PLC according to many functional and cost criteria under conditions of fuzzy information is developed. Examples of a PLC selection for conveyor automation are given.

articleTitle: Microstructure and electrical properties of biocompatible polyether-carbon nanotubes sensor materials
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The microstructure and electrical properties of biocompatible polyether-carbon nanotubes (MWCNTs) materials were studied using the methods of optical microscopy, fractal analysis and impedance spectroscopy. The effect of non-covalent modification of carbon nanotubes using polyethylene glycol (PEG) of different molecular weight on the degree of their distribution in the polymer matrix was studied. It was determined that for systems containing modified MWCNTs, a higher value of the fractal dimension is observed, which indicates the formation of looser MWCNT aggregates, while unmodified MWCNTs show a tendency to form denser aggregates. It was found that the value of the fractal dimension for functionalized MWCNTs is close to 3, which indicates a uniform distribution of MWCNTs. It was established that the modifier based on PEG10000 exerts the highest stabilizing effect. At the same time, MWCNTs are most evenly distributed throughout the volume of the material. It is found that obtained materials based on modified MWCNTs have relatively high level of electrical conductivity. This value makes such materials perspective for use in electrochemical sources.

articleTitle: Analysis of determination of fire resistance limits of cable lines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Fire Resistant cables are designed to maintain the circuit integrity of the cable even during fire conditions. In general, the fire-resistant cables are made up of flame retardant zero halogen materials, so that the fire hazard such as flame propagation and smoke release of these cables are controlled. These material characteristics show us completely dangerous of such emissions influence on humans and animals. That’s why all fire-resistant halogen-free materials are subject to destructive testing in a combustion chamber with connected gas analyzer. This paper describes the analysis of determination of cable lines fire resistance limits according to the existing Ukrainian test standards. Fire-resistant halogen-free cables were tested in a fire furnace located individually and in bundles. The limit of fire resistance and the class of the cable product are determined according to the fire resistance classification and temperature mode.

articleTitle: System for Prediction of the Technical Condition of Electric Power Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This paper analyzes the method of neuro-fuzzy modeling for forecasting the technical condition of elements of the electric power system. The model contains the following elements: a simulation model of a solar power plant, a simulation model of a wind generator, a simulation model of a synchronous generator acting as a thermal station. A special Fuzzy extension logic toolbox tool system was used to perform the simulation, designed to evaluate the quality of the synchronous generator. The received estimates of the technical condition of the equipment are processed using an adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system (ANFIS), resulting in a forecast of the technical condition of the equipment at a given time interval. Simulation of real systems by fuzzy models is based on the fact that fuzzy models of Sugeno type and Mamdani type are universal approximators of functions. The built model can be used in the design of renewable energy facilities, as well as in the development and testing of control and monitoring system algorithms. The system for evaluating and forecasting the condition of equipment using a fuzzy logic apparatus can be used to support decision-making by the operator of the power plant when determining the need for repair and replacement of equipment.

articleTitle: Assessment of the Impact of Fractal Dimension of the Fracture Surface of Cement Mortar on its Strength
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The study of the relationship between the structure and properties of cement mortars that make up concrete is complicated by the complex geometric structure of structural elements. The fractal approach was used to assess adequately the fracture surface of cement mortar with a plasticizer. The fractal dimension of the identified elements of mortar macrostructure is calculated: dark areas with cement stone predominance, light areas with sand predominance and pores. Linear models of strength prediction based on the influence of dark areas of the structure (the pair correlation coefficient is 0.77), light areas $(R^{2}=0.76)$ and pores $(R^{2}=0.72)$ are obtained, which indicates the sensitivity of physical and mechanical properties to changes in the fractal dimension of structural elements. An increase in the strength indicators of the mortar was recorded from 8 to 27 MPa with an increase in the fractal dimension of cement stone from 1.787 to 1.959 (by 8.9 %). Strength indicators decrease with an increase in the fractal dimension of light sections of the structure from 1.534 to 1.891 (by 19.9 %) and the fractal dimension of pores from 1.632 to 1.807 (by 9.7 %). A multiparametric fractal model of the influence of fractal dimensions of the identified structural components is constructed, which has a relatively high correlation coefficient of 0.89. The proposed approach can be used in industrial conditions as an additional method for operational forecasting of flexural strength indicators of cement mortar based on the fractal dimension of its macrostructure elements.

articleTitle: The Effect of Voltage and Current Harmonic Distortion on Power Indicators in Power Circuits a Dynamic Voltage Restorer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: On the basis of the developed model of the dynamic voltage restorer, a subsystem for measuring power indicators was built to assess its distribution in circuit elements. Experiments were conducted to determine the effect of harmonic distortion of voltage and current on integral power indicators in the power circuits of the dynamic voltage restorer. It is noted that there is distortion power in the converter circuits and on the filter elements, which for the inductance is comparable to the full power. Significant reactive power is distributed between the filter elements and the output lines of the converter. In this case, the reactive power of the capacitor is balanced by the reactive power of the inductor and the converter. The storage capacitor in the investigated mode gives active power to the external circuits.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation of the Energy Expenditures of the Thermostabilization Cycle of the Substrate in a Biogas Reactor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Purpose work is an experimental research of energy consumption for one cycle of thermostabilization the substrate to increase energy efficiency of the biogas production process. The working hypothesis of experimental research is that the use of a heating cable installed in stirrer paddles will ensure a reduction in energy costs for the process of thermal stabilization substrate during fermentation in biogas reactor, increasing energy efficiency of biogas production. The most important result research is obtained dependences temperature changes heating cable, the substrate and the use of energy for heating during one cycle of thermal stabilization of the substrate in an operating biogas plant. The significance of the research results presented in the work lies in the fact that when using an electric heating cable, which is mounted in the mixer blades, heating of the organic substrate occurs faster on average by 20.2%, and also a reduction in the amount of energy, spent on heating is achieved, the value of which is on average 27.2% in small volume biogas reactor. The use of two-position temperature control electrical heating sections installed in stirrer paddles ensures a decrease in the average power consumption for the substrate heating process in the biogas reactor by an average of 8.8%.

articleTitle: Exploratory Data Analysis in Wind Energy Datasets
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The analysis extends to multiple countries within the EU, highlighting distributions and correlations of wind power energy values. Specific correlations among countries, such as Austria, Belgium, Slovakia, and Hungary, are identified. The findings shed light on interdependencies and potential common development strategies among neighboring countries. The study concludes with density distributions of active power values, noting variations in Norway, Ireland, the United Kingdom, and possibly Finland. Overall, this research demonstrates the value of EDA in analyzing wind energy datasets and highlights the need for further exploration and development of methods for handling complex and multimodal data. The findings have practical implications for optimizing wind energy processes, predicting energy efficiency, and facilitating decision-making in the field.

articleTitle: Voltage regulation in electrical networks using booster transformers with thyristor control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: In the work, an equivalent circuit and mathematical models of a booster transformer were developed, considering the features of the connection diagram and the method of voltage regulation. Processes in the transformer are investigated and a method of voltage regulation is proposed, which excludes surges of the magnetizing current. The energy characteristics of the transformer are estimated and the region of its non-distorting operation is established.

articleTitle: Design Background Considerations of the Autonomous Power Supply System for Drones
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The development of intelligent technologies, communication systems, modern information and measurement equipment and multi-copter drones make it possible to create an organized systems capable of performing various tasks, including creating mobile systems for adaptive protection of critical infrastructure objects. The use of renewable energy sources and wireless energy transfer systems makes it possible to place an autonomous power supply systems for battery recharging in hard-to-reach places in the absence of stationary system and without the need for direct human presence. The autonomous power supply systems for drones are considered in this work. The structures of the onboard power supply and the general system have been proposed. The main discussions based on the consideration of such design have been provided for further developments.

articleTitle: Traffic Modeling for the Industrial Internet of NanoThings
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Industrial Internet of NanoThings (IIoNT) traffic model proposed. The model is based on the developed algorithm for Dynamic Data Composition Control. The application of the algorithm made it possible to reduce the total amount of transmitted information from the end nodes of IIoNT. The model made it possible to determine the parameters of aggregation traffic of IIoNT cluster gateway. With the calculated parameters, the value of the aggregated package is maximized. The main limitation is not exceeding the value of the boundary delay for the transmission of sensor readings. The model also allows you to dynamically determine the required amount of the gateway buffer memory.

articleTitle: Efficiency of the Floating Power Plant with of Fuel Thermochemical Treatment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The main aim of the research is an analysis of characteristics of advanced floating power plants with the thermochemical regeneration of waste heat. The power plant was investigated by methods of mathematical modeling. The influence of water cost and water/fuel ratio on the efficiency of a floating power plant with thermochemical fuel treatment was researched. The calculation scheme of combined plant with the fuel thermochemical treatment is demonstrated. The results of mathematical simulation of the processes in power plant under the 35.7 MW.The plant consists of: Siemens SGT 400 gas turbine engine, two Wartsila12V50DF internal combustion engines and two utilization-type desalination units. The characteristics of gas turbine engines, internal combustion engines, subsystems of thermochemical treatment were determined separately. The component models were connected by the links in the form of material and energy flows. Mathematical models of the gas-turbine engine, the recovery circuit, and the thermochemical fuel treatment unit were created using the Aspen Plus physicochemical process modeling system. Workflows in the ICE were modeled using the software package CHEMKIN. It is determined that for gaseous hydrocarbon fuels with the ratio of the cost of water to the cost of fuel more than 0.1, the increase in efficiency does not exceed 1.

articleTitle: Computer-integrated drive control in systems with variable imbalance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The paper introduces a computer-integrated system designed for the automatic control in centrifuges with variable imbalance. The system comprises a microcontroller, a Hall sensor, a computer-oriented Bond Graph model of an asynchronous motor, and a control program. The control program utilizes a proposed algorithm to monitor the nominal and critical values of the centrifuge drive current while continuously recording and observing the current. If there is an increase in the current, the system automatically resets the revolutions by 10%, aiming to minimize vibration amplitude during transient rotational modes. Subsequently, the system oversees the permissible current limit and engine load to ensure stable operation.

articleTitle: Double-Circuit Overhead Power Lines Magnetic Field Combined Electromagnetic Passive and Active Shielding in Multi-Story Residential Building
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The work presents a model of a combined passive and active shielding of a magnetic field generated by double-circuit overhead lines in a multistory residential building. While designing the combined shield at invariability of the passive shield parameters, we find the optimal geometry parameters of two active shielding windings, the current values, and the phases of each shielding winding. The design problem of the combined passive and active shield includes the creation of a robust two-circuit system of active shield and passive shield of an initial magnetic field.
