It involves solving a two-player multi-criteria antagonistic zero-sum game. The game payoff vector is calculated by COMSOL Multiphysics using the finite element method. The game solution is obtained using derivative-free optimization method. We perform a computer simulation of the efficiency of the model of combined passive and active shielding of the magnetic field generated by double-circuit overhead lines in a multistory residential building. It shows the possibility of reducing the initial magnetic field to the safe reference level of 0.5 $\mu T$ for living space.

articleTitle: Isotherms of Lattice Thermal Conductivity and Self-Organization Processes in Semiconductor Pb1-xSnxTe Solid Solutions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The isotherms of total $\lambda$, electronic $\lambda_{\mathrm{E}}$ and lattice $\lambda_{\mathrm{L}}$ thermal conductivities were obtained in the temperature range (300 - 700) K for the polycrystalline samples of semiconductor $\mathrm{Pb}_{1-\mathrm{I}}\mathrm{Sn}_{\mathrm{I}}\mathrm{Te}$ solid solutions $(\mathrm{x}=0-1)$ prepared from the bulk cast annealed alloys. It was shown that $\lambda_{L}$ varies nonmonotonically, having minima near $x=0.20$ and $x =0.7$. The observed nonmonotonic behavior of the dependence of $\lambda_{\mathrm{L}}$ on the composition is attributed to the manifestation of self-organization processes in these solid solutions that take place at certain compositions corresponding to the stoichiometric ratio of components in the cationic sublattice. It is suggested that it is the processes of redistribution of Pb and Sn cations leading to the formation of ordered structures that stimulate the transition into the topological TCI state after the transition into a gapless state and formation of an inversion band structure.

articleTitle: Relative navigation of UAV in a swarm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The problem of obtaining high-precision coordinate values in a UAV swarm is considered. The hierarchical structure of a UAV swarm, the composition of onboard equipment and the exchanged information is developed. For high-precision local distance measurements between UAVs it is proposed to use modulated acoustic ultrasound radiation. Synchronization of acoustic signals and information exchange between UAV-manager and other vehicles is carried out in the radio band. To simplify the solution, GNSS measurements are used as an initial approximation if they are available. The refinement of measurements for all UAVs is solved with the UAV-manager, and the results are transmitted to the subscribers for usage in a flight control. The positive simulation results are presented.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Parametric Design of Two Degree of Freedom Robust Control by Electromechanical Tracking Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The work presents the optimization procedure for robust structural-parametric multi-objective design for two-contour tracking system. This two-contour tracking system include open-loop and closed-loop control. Robust structural-parametric design of two-contour tracking system reduce to calculate solution of vector minimax problem. This solution of vector minimax problem calculate based on optimization by metaheuristic Archimedes algorithm. Theoretical and experimental research of two-contour tracking systems during their operation in various modes given. Simultaneous use of open-loop and closed-loop control made it possible to increase two-contour tracking system accuracy in various modes.

articleTitle: The Two Stage Method for Detecting Objects of Interest on Optical Satellite RGB Imagery of the Urban Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: It is proposed to develop the two stages method for detecting objects of interest on optical satellite RGB imagery of the urban infrastructure. The paper analyzes approaches to the detection of urban infrastructure objects on remote sensing imagery of the earth. It presents their advantages and disadvantages. It is proposed to use one of the methods of swarm intelligence, namely, the ant colony optimization algorithm at the first stage. At the second stage, the Hough transform is used to extract straight lines from the total number of detectted edges at the first stage. It is presented the results of segmentation of optical satellite RGB image of the urban infrastructure by the proposed method after each of the stages. The evaluation of the quality of the results of the method was only visual.

articleTitle: An Application for Research of Object Selection and Tracking in Images
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The work is devoted to the process of research and development of an object selection and tracking in images. The article offers a solution to the problem of crossing the bounding frames that arises in the operation of YOLO and R-CNN type neural networks by developing a method for estimating the optimal size of the search area, which will allow finding the appropriate object and its bounding frame, and offer a generalized approach to the visualization of the research process, which will allow to visually represent the overlap of the bounding frames and will facilitate the selection of the optimal object. To confirm the effectiveness of the proposed method, there conduct experiments on the appropriate data set.

articleTitle: Plasmon Mode of Plane Dielectric Waveguide With Infinite Graphene Film Scattering by Finite Number of Graphene Strips
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: We consider the scattering of the H-polarized plasmon mode of the dielectric waveguide with graphene infinite film by the graphene strip grating. At the first step, we determine the propagation constants and field amplitude of the plasmon mode. At the second step we consider scattering problem of this mode by the finite number of graphene strips, placed on the top of the waveguide. Here solution is obtained by the method of singular integral equations. Our solution is full-wave and meshless. For discretization, the Nystrom-type method is used. The convergence is based on the corresponding theorems. We study the possibility of control the angle of the main lobe of the radiation pattern by variation of the chemical potential of the graphene.

articleTitle: Improvement of Clinical Hematological Diagnostics Due to the Use of Three-Dimensional Images of Erythrocytes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The modern level of nanoelectronic technologies and high-tech electronic equipment allowed us to reach a new level in medical instrumentation, including for laboratory medical research. The authors considered the possibility of obtaining morphological features of erythrocytes through the use of a polychrome holographic microscope with subsequent processing of the obtained images by the improved spectral method. The obtained results made it possible to significantly improve the quality of diagnostic information, which implies further improvement of methods of laboratory clinical diagnostics.

articleTitle: Cloud System of Content Accounting with Access on OC Android and IOS
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The article analyzes features of functioning of content accounting cloud system on the example of books text and audio files. Comparative analysis of the existing analogues has been done; rational means of software primary functions realization have been defined. An example of realization has been provided; quality of the mobile application operation has been assessed.

articleTitle: Hardware Methods for Determination of the Characteristics of Incoherent Scatter Signals in Radar Remote Sensing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The results of the generalization and modification of the structure of radar equipment and ionospheric sounding procedures are given. It is proposed to use optimal variants of sounding signals that are maximally compatible with the characteristics of the ionospheric plasma at different altitudes. The procedures of determination of the statistical characteristics of the incoherent scatter signal in the modes of radiation of a long sounding pulse, composite two-element and three-element pulses, and a sequence of double pulses were analyzed. A radiation mode is proposed when using elements of a composite pulse signal with different directions of the circular radio wave polarization. Cases of using specialized multi-channel and programmable correlators in radar processing systems for calculating autocorrelation and cross-correlation functions of the scatter signal are considered.

Author Keywords: specialized computer processing of radar signals
autocorrelation and cross-correlation functions of the scatter signal

articleTitle: Research of Accumulator Blocks of Electric Vehicles and Charging Station Based on Current Source Rectifier
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The article presents a study of batteries and electric vehicle charging systems. A comparative analysis of the characteristics of Li-Ion, Li-Fe-PO4 and Li-Ti batteries is presented. Active voltage-source rectifier and current-source active rectifier are proposed as converters for electric vehicle charging stations. In the Matlab/Simulink program, a model of an electric car charging station based on current-source rectifier which charges a 85 kWh battery, has been developed. Transient processes of the converter are determined, as well as the spectrum of higher harmonics of the input current.

articleTitle: Cost-Effective Software and Hardware Complex to Ensure Security Against Unauthorized Use of Enemy Commercial Uavs on the Combat Territory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The rapid development in unmanned aerial systems (UAS) has raised concerns about security in both civilian and military domains. Remote identification of UAS, crucial for ensuring legality and ownership verification in real-time, poses challenges. This article explores the improvement of software and hardware complexes to counter the unauthorized use of enemy commercial UAVs on combat territories. Different data transfer protocols used by UAS, such as MAVLink, DJI OcuSync, Lightbridge, Datalink, and LTE/4G/5G, are compared based on their technical characteristics. The article highlights the vulnerabilities in identity forgery that can compromise privacy and operational security, emphasizing the need for robust remote identification systems. It discusses controversies surrounding DJI's DroneID protocol and the utilization of the DJI AeroScope Monitoring System. The limitations and problems associated with existing hardware solutions are addressed, and the benefits of using budget-friendly equipment for combatting dual-purpose commercial UAS are highlighted. The proposed detection system offers cost-effectiveness, scalability, mobility, and adaptability to counter evolving enemy UAS control methods, ensuring improved security on the front lines.

articleTitle: Development of a modified extruded plastic cooling system for FDM printing technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This paper examines the features and advantages of a non-standard cooling system, which consists in moving the printed volume cooling cooler from the printer extruder to the X-axis portal. Cooling system can be used in the open-type printers, such as Ender 3, to increase the rate of hardening of the extruded plastic and reduce the inertia of the extruder.

articleTitle: Parameters determination and development of seasonal cold accumulators with phase transformation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The study aims to determine the relationship between energy parameters, geometric parameters, and thermophysical properties of the battery’s constituent elements. The highest battery power values are observed during the stage of cooling the material to the phase transformation temperature and heating the material after the phase transformation. The lowest power output of the battery is observed during the heating of the material to the phase transformation temperature and cooling of the material after the phase transformation, primarily due to limited heat exchange of the storage substance in its solid state.

articleTitle: Accelerated Algorithm for Ridge and Valley Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The paper considers methods for ridge and valley detection in images, including maps of the earth's surface, both real and synthesized. The relevance of this task is due to the fact that the processing of digital elevation maps and the detection of informationally important objects on them has found wide application in agriculture, hydrogeological research, and road construction. The proposed methods make it possible to detect both ridges and valleys, as well as combined structures that include both types of objects. In this case, it is easy to vary both the general sensitivity of the method and the individual sensitivity to the ridge and valley detection. Modifications of the methods have also been proposed that provide a reduction in software and hardware complexity, which will make it possible to implement image processors on microcontrollers and FPGAs and use them in on-board equipment placed on drones. Algorithms can be accelerated, on the one hand, by rounding the coefficients of smoothing filters to powers of two, and, on the other hand, by accelerating the calculation of eigenvalues. The methods have proved their effectiveness in processing digital maps of the earth's surface. The results of the work can be used in the construction of software and hardware image processing systems.

articleTitle: A method for targeting unmanned aerial vehicles for a distributed intelligent control system for a group of dissimilar unmanned aerial vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: the application of a distributed intelligent control system for a group of unmanned aerial vehicles is substantiated, a method for coordinating their interaction to maximize the target indicator is proposed and substantiated on the example of servicing several unequally important targets in an autonomous mode.

articleTitle: Laboratory Equipment for the Solar Power Plants Studying
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The paper presents the experience of developing and implementing a solar power plant in the laboratory of the Department of Electrical Engineering of Kremenchuk Mykhailo Ostrohradskyi National University. The structure of the educational and research complex, its composition are considered. The main technical characteristics of the components of the solar power plant are given. The functional capacity of the developed equipment for the organization of a laboratory workshop is shown, in particular, when measuring the current and voltage at the output of a solar inverter using the Fluke 434 network parameters analyzer. The experimentally obtained values of the amount of electricity produced by a single-phase solar network inverter PIKO-2.0 from KOSTAL Solar Electric GmbH company (Germany) connected to the university network are presented. A comparative calculation of the economic efficiency of this type of micro-electric power plant was carried out.

articleTitle: Research of an Automated Control System for the Technological Process of a Rolling Mill with the Application of the Electroplastic Effect
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The automatic control systems for the wire drawing process using the electroplastic wire drawing method have been considered. A functional diagram for generating the required current pulses for the pulse current source, which is the basis for performing the technological operation, is provided. Initial data and parameters for calculating the process of stimulating the electroplastic effect are given. The main electrical values that contribute to the electroplastic effect are presented in the form of a table. The power consumption required to implement the necessary current pulses for the electroplastic effect is mathematically calculated based on the process conditions. The operation of the developed automatic control system relies on maintaining a constant specified drawing force. This is achieved by adjusting the frequency, amplitude, and pulse duration of the pulse current based on the tension force value. An adaptive controller capable of self-tuning and building its own mathematical relationship for the controlled process is used in the design of the control system. An algorithm has been developed that allows the controller to adjust the level of frequency, current amplitude, and pulse duration based on the required (specified) tension force value. The results of the research on the electrocontact heating process at PAT “PlazmaTek” in Rudnitsa are presented. Conclusions have been drawn from the research findings for further implementation of the electroplastic effect in production.

articleTitle: Explore the Possibility of Non-contact Movement of Small Permanent Magnets in Magnetic Stereotaxic Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: In this paper, the possibility of non-contact of small permanent magnets in magnetic stereotaxic systems is introduced, and the influence of external magnetic field strength changes on small permanent magnets is calculated by simulation software.

articleTitle: Electromechanical System Of Control And Determination Of Strength Of Concrete By Non-Destructive Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The current trend in the development of non-destructive testing of materials in the building industry is mainly concerned with the detection of flaws and defects in concrete elements and structures, and acoustic methods are prospects in this field. An important indicator of the quality of concrete is strength. However, non-destructive testing methods do not allow direct linking of the electrical characteristics with the strength. In this paper, in the form of a graphical dependence using an electromechanical installation based on experimental studies, the relationship between strength and acoustic impedance is shown.

articleTitle: Classified emotion as implicit recommendation system feedback
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: the paper proposes the use of 3D convolutional neural network for recognizing user emotions on videos in a recommender system. The data approach aims to use the recognized emotion as important implicit feedback and improve the recommendation result. This is expected to significantly improve the performance of the recommender system.

articleTitle: Model of a peer-to-peer trading system for prosumers involving a Distributed System Operator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The paper discusses the issue of peer-to-peer trading between prosumers. Due to the increase in the amount of Distributed Generation in the Power Grid, it became possible to reduce power flows in the grid. This in turn will reduce power and voltage losses. Due to this, it becomes possible to prosumers to become participants in the Energy Market, and ordinary consumers to receive energy at prices lower than in the base tariffs set by electricity supplying organizations. The article is devoted to the analysis of trade in electric energy of prosumers between themselves and ordinary consumers, as well as participation in this process of Distributed System Operators. The concept of peer-to-peer trade formation and system model are considered. Investigate the role of different types of prosumers, their economic incentives, penalties for non-compliance. Prosumer model is considered in detail, including loads, renewable energy sources, battery energy storage system and switching equipment.

articleTitle: Method and algorithms for minimizing temperature errors of spacecraft fiber-optic gyroscopes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The calculation method and algorithms used to calibrate fiber-optic gyroscopes installed in instrument clusters of artificial Earth satellites are described. A mathematical statement of the problem of non-stationary heat transfer is given. The considered problem is solved using a combination of the Finite Element Method and the Finite difference method of time integration. Thermal changes that occur in the satellite body during its motion in near-Earth orbit are considered and modeled. The temperature distributions in the satellite body and directly in the fiber-optic gyroscope are determined. The found distributions was used to substantiate the requirements for ground-based calibration of gyroscopes in order to build the corresponding compensating models. In addition, the obtained dependence of temperatures on time is used for operation algorithms under conditions of gyroscope temperature uncertainty, for example, due to a temperature sensor failure. Thus, a new approach to minimizing the temperature error of instruments as part of onboard orientation and navigation systems, which increases their fault tolerance, is presented.

articleTitle: Synthesis of an Optimal Control Algorithm for a Transport Conveyor with a Reversing Section
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The analytical model of the conveyor reversing section for the synthesis of the optimal control algorithm of flow parameters of the transport system is researched. At a constant belt speed of the conveyor, the values of the flow parameters of the reversing section are determined according to the given values of the input flow. The model of the reversing section is based on the analytical PiKh-model with a constant transport delay. The relevance of developing an analytical model of the reversing section is caused by the practical need to build algorithms for optimal control of the flow parameters of a transport system with a variable structure of the transportation route. This model can be used to form a data set for training a neural network in a multi-section transport pipeline model. It is assumed that the belt speed is constant, the switching process is instantaneous, the interval between switching points is more than the transport delay. The optimal control problem of the flow parameters of the section is formulated. For the synthesis of optimal control, the Pontryagin maximum principle is used. According to the given quality criterion, the Hamiltonian of the system was written. The optimal control algorithm of the flow parameters for the transport system has been synthesized. The belt speed switching points have been defined. The proposed model can be used to design a control system with a changing structure of the transport route to decrease the specific transport costs in the mining industry.

articleTitle: The Effect of Kinematic Excitation on the Blades Vibration Stress State of the Last Stage High-Power Steam Turbine with Blade Mistuning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This article investigates the effect of kinematic excitation on the vibration stress state of blades in the mistuned disk of a last stage high-power steam turbine. Turbo-machines often experience deviations in blade geometry and bandage connection conditions, leading to variations in the cyclic symmetry of the blade-disk system. Additionally, erosive damage can occur in the blades due to high humidity in low-pressure cylinders. Repairing damaged blades introduces changes in their natural frequencies, further broking the cyclic symmetry. The objective of this study is to assess the influence of the broken cyclic symmetry on the stress state of blades in the last stage of a high-power steam turbine. A finite element model is developed to analyze the vibrations of the blade-disk system, considering kinematic excitation caused by the movement of the shaft’s center. The computational studies reveal resonant regions and changes in maximum equivalent stresses in the blades. The results demonstrate that kinematic excitation affects the stress distribution in the blades, with increased stresses observed near the rotation frequency. The findings emphasize the importance of considering kinematic excitation when evaluating the vibration reliability of blades in mistuned disk configurations. Understanding the stress behavior and its relationship to cyclic symmetry can contribute to prolonging the safe operation of repaired blades and ensuring the reliability of steam turbine systems.

articleTitle: Development of a PSO Modification with Soft Particle Reinitialization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: A modification of particle swarm optimization (PSO) with soft reinitialization of particles was developed in the article. It forces random particles (but not the best ones) to change their positions and velocities. In the frame of the investigation (for four benchmarks and thirty particles in a swarm) the reasonable number of particles to reinitialize equals one. A comparative study shows the advantages and a drawback of developed PSO modification.

articleTitle: Analysis of DC-DC volt-inverting Luo converter with reduced output voltage ripples operating in DCM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The electromagnetic processes in volt-inverting Luo converter in discontinuous conduction mode (DCM) were studied using the method of averaging in state space based on Lagrange theorems. With the help of this method, a mathematical model was obtained, which made it possible to develop analytical relations for calculating the processes in converter in the DCM mode. The ratios for average and ripple values of currents and voltages in the reactive elements of converter, as well as the corresponding ripple factors, were obtained. These ratios contribute to simplification of converter calculations and allow to realize necessary output parameters with a given limitation on the magnitude of output voltage ripples and storage inductor current ripples. Graphical dependences of output voltage ripple factor of converter were calculated to illustrate the conducted research. It is shown that compared to traditional topology of the buck-boost converter, the output filter in volt-inverting Luo converter allows to reduce the ripple coefficient of output voltage by a number of times proportional to product of values of inductance and capacitance of the filter, as well as of the commutation frequency square.

articleTitle: Complex Frequency Eigenvalue Problem for Circular Dielectric Rod Partially Covered with Graphene
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: We consider the two-dimensional electromagnetic complex-frequency eigenvalue problem for the natural modes of circular dielectric rod with partial graphene cover. The surface impedance of graphene is characterized by the quantum-theory Kubo equations. To reduce the problem to a well-conditioned determinantal equation, we use the method of analytical regularization based on explicit inversion of the static part of the problem. To find the roots of truncated determinantal equation, we apply the residual inverse iteration method. This analysis reveals the presence of the plasmon modes of the curved strip of graphene and the modes of the circular dielectric rod, perturbed by the presence of the strip. If the rod radius is measured in micrometers, the real parts of all these eigenfrequencies are comparable, however, the plasmon mode Q-factors are higher.

articleTitle: Regimes Characteristics of a Three-Phase Combined Compensation Rectifier
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The results of the study of electromagnetic processes in a three-phase combined compensation rectifier are presented. Attention is focused on their features, which consist in the fact that the power electric valves of the compensation part of the rectifier (diodes) operate with a leading regulation angle. This is due to the voltage capacitors of the commutating link. The value of the leading angle of regulation depends on a number of factors: the value of the phase capacitance of the commutating capacitors, the inductance of the AC circuit, the magnitude of the load current and the moment switch the transistors of the commutating link. Taking them into account is a complex task, the solution of which opens up opportunities for determining the extent of switching processes, the rectifier’s ability to compensate and generate reactive energy, and the magnitude of the rectified voltage.

articleTitle: Analysis of Finite-Difference Approximation of Code TETCH-M in Performing Design Calculations of Parameters in the Primary and Secondary Circuits of VVER RP
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: In code package TETCH-M energy and coolant hydrodynamics equations, neutron kinetics equations and equations of heat conduction in metalwork and fuel rods are solved together. Processes described by these equations are characterized by different time constants and during calculation different degree of time and space discretization is required. The objective of the work was demonstration of stability of numerical schemes used in TETCH-M program and its modules, assessment of error of numerical solution for nodalization. Initial differential equations in partial derivative of the law of conservation of mass, energy and momentum are reduced to the system of usual differential equations on the basis of spatial approximation with the use of integro-interpolation method. Approximation was performed by integrating the initial differential equations in partial derivatives within the limits of each elemental volume of division by spatial coordinate. The usage of integro-interpolation method provides fulfilment of laws of conservation on computational mesh as a whole (conservatism of approximation method) and the second order of approximation by spatial coordinate.

articleTitle: Dynamic Pricing in Transactive Energy System with Solar, Wind-generators and Diesel Generator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: A transactive energy system is aimed at achieving specific economic and operational goals related to the coordinated integration of consumers, electricity producers and renewable sources. All electricity producers, the power grid operator, consumers and active consumers share energy bids and offers via a transactional trading platform based on dynamic pricing. The transactive energy system includes various types of sources. The composition of power sources shall be determined based on the user’s needs and the ability to control power generation modes. The paper show a dynamic pricing system the prices of which are set close to real-time electricity consumption for a system consisting of three different generator types: a solar generator, a wind generator, and a diesel generator. The system is part of a transactional system. Estimation of the cost of electricity for a local system with pricing every 10, 20, and 60 minutes The obtained cost schedules are the basis for the formation of a dynamic pricing. The average value of the calculated costs per day is 5.4% higher for 20-minute measurement than for ten-minute measurement

articleTitle: Optimization Terms of Equipment Replacement Based on the Profit Intensity Criterion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: optimizing the terms of equipment (in particular, electrical) replacement is relevant from a practical (due to the wear and tear of many types of domestic equipment) and theoretical (due to the uncertainty of this issue) points of view.In the relevant literature there is still no consensus even on the fundamental question of the criterion of optimality itself - which indicator to consider as a priority, over what period of time to form it, to what (to an individual piece of equipment or to a chain of successively replaceable instances) to apply it.It has been established that the most appropriate indicator for use as a criterion is the intensity of profit (profit per unit of time) from the chain of successively replaced pieces of equipment: profit as such provides a comparison of income and costs; considering not only a given instance of equipment, but their sequential chain implements a systematic approach, allows you to reflect moral and more correctly take into account physical wear and tear; dividing the amount of profit by the time it is received is necessary to overcome the difficulties associated with the unlimited planning period. optimization according to this criterion provides a significantly greater - in comparison with decision-making according to other criteria - total profit over a significant period of time.The optimality condition for the equipment operation term according to the adopted criterion is found analytically, its visual interpretation, substantiating a graphic method of solving this optimization problem, is given. The factors forming the chosen optimality criterion are established, and their influence on the equipment operation term optimal according to this criterion is determined.

articleTitle: Magnetic Field Sensors Placement for Overhead Power Lines Magnetic Field Active Cleanliness System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The work presents optimization procedure two-degrees freedom system active cleanliness magnetic field sensors placement double-circuits overhead power lines magnetic field in multi-story residential building. Overhead power lines magnetic field system active cleanliness magnetic field sensors placement calculated based on local objective binary preference relations for multi-objective minimax optimization problem. Multi-objective minimax vector optimization problem objective function calculated based on Biot-Savart’s law. Vector minimax optimization problem solution calculated based on nonlinear Archimedes algorithm. Computer simulation and experimental research results optimal magnetic field sensors placement of two degrees of freedom active cleanliness system of double-circuits overhead power lines magnetic field in multi-story residential building given.

articleTitle: Digital Implementation of Relay Protection Algorithms. Transformer Differential Protection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This research paper focuses on the development of a software implementation of transformer differential protection algorithms, with the aim of further using this technology in a central relay protection server. It is based on a Fourier filter. As a result of the research the implementation code is given as well as graphs of the protection signals in case of phase A accidents.

articleTitle: Solar Gain in the Buildings of Unconventional Shape
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: An account the solar heat gain of the rooms from the sky through the light apertures is an important stage in the determining the energy efficiency class of buildings. This issue has been studied in sufficient detail for rooms and light apertures of a conventional shape (rectangular rooms and light apertures). The article proposes principles for determining solar heat gains for rooms and light apertures of unconventional shape. A classification of unconventional objects and their elements is proposed. Heat gains from scattered solar radiation were determined using the mathematical apparatus of point calculus. For the main variants of structural forms there have been developed point equations which form the field of scanning points.The elementary values of solar heat gains were determined within the boundaries of the elementary pyramids, the vertices of which are located at the calculated points, and their faces pass through three or four adjacent scanning points on the surface of the light aperture. The sum of all elementary values gives the total value of solar heat gain entering an unconventional room through an unconventional light aperture.

articleTitle: The Length of Flight Plan Calculation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Airspace users give special requirements to selection of efficient airplane trajectories during the pre-flight planning stage. A set of waypoints could be chosen based on criteria of lowes fees, required fuel, smallest flight time, and shortest length with taking into account requirements of insuring required level of flight safety. Separation minimums in horizontal and vertical planes provide a safety buffer between airspace users. In the paper, we consider different algorithms of length of flight route calculation and analyze their application for parameters of flight plan estimation. We compare direct distance calculation in Euclidean space, the lenth of a great circle line, the length of rhumb (loxodrome) line, and arch length formed by isobaric surface which is used for airplane flight leveling. We consider an actual weather action on Estimated Time Enroute between waypoints and Time of Arrival at each waypoint. A flight-planned route from Los Angeles international airport to Chicago O’hare international airport is used as an example for parameters of flight plan calculation with different lengths.

articleTitle: Detection Changes in Line Insulation Conductivity by High-Frequency Voltage and Current Pulsations Using Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The cable line is one of the main elements in the power transmission system, but due to the cable lines considerable length, monitoring the line condition and tracking its damage is a complex process. In practice, methods quite a variety are used to monitor the line condition, through monitoring the change in current and voltage in high-voltage cable lines with long distances, and control parameters using equivalent circuits.Study object is a short cable line, 6 km long, with a connected source of 6 kV, in a network with a non-linear load. Given its short-length, the overall changes in voltage and current will not have significant deviations between the input and output of the cable line. The main observation is carried out in the high frequencies area at a 2500 Hz frequency with the expectation of evident deviations in the current and voltage caused by the influence a non-linear load.By conducting two experiments, a line without damage and a line with damaged insulation, a number of deviations in the pulses change over time were revealed. The most evident deviations occur in the current, which is expressed due to a change in the main pulses amplitude and the significant appearance low-amplitude fluctuations between damaged phases under the influence of opposite-phase pulses.

articleTitle: Point and Interval Frequensy Estimation in the Non-Coherent Sampling by Separate Analysis of Fourier Transform Components
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This paper presents an approach for point and interval frequency estimation based on applying of a criterion for the assessment of level of spectral leakage for the analyzed signal. The unknown frequency is estimated by the repetitive calculations of Fourier transform components for various duration of the analyzed signal till the moment when the proposed criterion does not indicate the lowest level of spectral leakage. The presented approach is developed both for the cases of coherent and non-coherent sampling. In the case of the coherent sampling the unknown frequency is estimated based on zero values of the distinguished characteristic elements of the sidelobes, which indicate absence of spectral leakage. In the non-coherent sampling the unknown frequency is estimated by establishing the boundaries of frequency interval with the exact frequency of the analyzed signal with further applying of weight coefficients determined by the values of the proposed criterion, indicating the level of spectral leakage.

articleTitle: Bioimpedance Analysis of Biological Tissues for Their Welding
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The work is devoted to the analysis of biomedical parameters of living biological tissues related to their impedance. In modern clinical monitoring systems, measuring transducers of electrical impedance of organs and tissues is widely used for diagnostic studies. Biological impedance measurement tasks are based on the ability of biological tissues, including the human body, to conduct electric current. It is difficult to measure the true resistance of a part of the body on direct current due to the polarization of biological tissues and the appearance of parasitic charges on the electrodes. Therefore, for measuring biological impedance, alternating current is preferred. In this work, the electrical equivalent impedance circuits of biological tissues are studied with MicroCap Software. The results can be useful for calculating welding parameters for the welding of biological tissues.

articleTitle: The assessment of the leakage current through pin-type insulators with defect or contaminated of medium voltage overhead power lines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: In Ukraine, most of the 6-10 kV networks are implemented as overhead power lines with bare aluminum wire and pin-type insulation which operating with insulated neutral. In such power lines, most often damaged is single-phase-to-earth fault trough pin insulator, and as a result, the pin insulation is the most unreliable element. Existing systems and devices do not allow predicting insulation defect. The article proposes the concept of the measuring part of the device for beforehand diagnosis of pin insulator. To assess the possibility of such a diagnosis the leakage current is established in the normal operating condition of the insulation and with contamination or defective insulation. For this, the dependence of “pin-insulator-wire” capacitance is established for the range of dielectric conductivity characteristic of electroporcelain and the range of wire diameters characteristic of 6-10 kV overhead power lines.

articleTitle: ML-surrogate modeling for the estimation of random system performance parameter progress by the Chained Gaussian Process Regression method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The ability to accurately forecast productivity parameters is of great importance in various fields, such as engineering designs and structures, workforce management, and economic analysis. However, forecasting such parameters is challenging due to their inherent stochastic nature and time dependence, as well as the presence of heteroscedasticity in data. In this study, we aim to address these challenges by developing a surrogate model that can effectively predict the productivity parameter, taking into account its random process over time and heteroscedastic characteristics.

articleTitle: Voltage-Current Control in Fully Active Hybrid Energy Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The paper presents control design and analysis of the fully active hybrid energy storage systems (HESS) based on batteries and supercapacitors (SC). Using standard averaged model of the bidirectional DC-DC buck-boost power converters, an improved partially feedback linearizing cascaded voltage-current controller has been designed. For stability analysis and controller tuning, the linearized system dynamics is studied. The proposed nonlinear transformations and feedback linearizing controllers allow, for the first time, to justify the tuning of the DC-link voltage and current controllers parameters for the original nonlinear non-minimum phase system using its linear approximation around the trajectories, corresponding to power balance equation. It is shown that a time-scale separation between voltage and current dynamics is required in order to ensure asymptotic stability and desired transient performances. For HESS, a modified frequency decoupling filter is derived with added SC charge current component. A novel SC average voltage controller and its tuning technique guarantee relatively slow dynamics of SC voltage regulation with limited effect on DC-link voltage regulation and currents distribution. The results of simulation study confirm the effectiveness of the proposed control system.

articleTitle: Investigation of the relationship between the voltage level of the EMG signal and the coefficient of elasticity of the muscles of the nasal valve
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The possibilities of the electromyography method for functional diagnostics of the nasal valve are considered. Methods for analyzing the electromyography signal of the nasal valve muscles are proposed. The possibilities and prospects of these methods for diagnosing nasal valve pathologies are discussed. The obtained research results make it possible to assess the degree of nasal valve rigidity by amplitude and frequency analysis of the electromyography signal, which shows the relationship between the voltage level of the EMG signal and the coefficient of elasticity of the nasal valve muscles.

articleTitle: Control Characteristics of Zero-Current-Switching Quasi-Resonant Boost Converter under Variation of Resonant Circuit and Load Parameters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The investigation of resonant circuit parameters influence on the control characteristics behavior in a boost half-wave zero-current switching quasi-resonant converter is presented. The dependences of the control pulses duration and operating frequency as well as electric characteristics under variation of resonant circuit time constant and control pulses duty cycle are established by the numeric simulation and are represented as 3D-surfaces. The dependences of these characteristics under variation of load impedance and control pulses duty cycle are also obtained. The obtained results can be used in the process of developing and constructing a table-based, robust multi-loop or nonlinearity compensated control systems for quasi-resonant converters.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the energy efficiency of the infrared long-wave heating system in various applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The paper presents the calculation of energy consumption for heating buildings with three different heating systems, in order to determine the feasibility of using long-wave radiant heaters. As a calculation methodology, the current rules of energy certification of buildings and related state standards of Ukraine were used. A technical and economic analysis was carried out, due to which savings from the transition to a radiant heating system in residential, public and industrial buildings that are in the same weather environment.

articleTitle: Energy And Economic Aspects Of Creating The Electric Drive Of A Trolleybus With Autonomous Running
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Comparison of financial costs for the extension of the trolleybus route by building a contact network in comparison with the modernization of the trolleybus into a trolleybus with autonomous running on a hybrid power source of the "battery - supercapacitor" type is made. A functional diagram of a modernized electric drive is proposed. Expressions are given for estimating the energy that returns to the power source in regenerative braking modes, when speed is reduced, and also when moving at a constant speed during descent. A technique is proposed and the features of choosing the parameters of storage and supercapacitor batteries are indicated. Equations for calculation are presented and an example of their use is given. The influence of the use of a supercapacitor battery on the improvement of the thermal regime of the battery is indicated.

articleTitle: Growing Elliptical RBF Network for Power Plant Return Water Temperature Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The study aims to improve the radial basis function (RBF) neural network learning method based on a genetic algorithm to speed up finding optimal parameters of a combined heat and power (CHP) plant return water temperature model. A growing hidden layer approach is used to simplify network learning and avoid overfitting. The test results prove that the proposed initialization of an elliptical RBF network with only a small number of active neurons allows reaching the desired accuracy faster for both the standard deviation and the maximum absolute prediction error. Learning is performed on the Kharkiv CHP plant #5 heat output data.

articleTitle: Extension to Three-Capacitance Equivalent Circuit for Simulation of Internal Partial Discharges in Multiple Gaseous Cavities
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This paper examines simulation of partial discharges that occur inside defective solid insulation containing multiple gaseous cavities. The formation of voids and cavities in high-voltage insulation is the main cause of internal partial discharges. Although the magnitude of partial discharge is quite small, but over time it leads to an accelerated degradation of the insulation, which ultimately ends in electrical breakdown. Since partial discharges occur in voids and cavities inside electrical insulation, they are inaccessible to direct measurement and observation. Therefore, due to the threat they pose to insulation, comprehensive modeling of partial discharge is an important task Until recently, when simulating partial discharges using the well-known three-capacitance equivalent circuit, in most cases, the defect in the insulation itself was represented only by a single gaseous cavity. The extended equivalent circuit proposed in this paper allows simulation of partial discharges in multiple voids or cavities, that is more consistent with real insulation defects, and also takes into account the mutual influence of neighboring gaseous cavities. Method of mixed analog and digital circuit simulation was applied for modeling of localized dielectric breakdown of a defective portion of a solid electrical insulation. Obtained results contribute to methods of modeling the complex breakdown processes in electrical insulation and can be used in virtual experiments and for educational purposes.

articleTitle: Determination of Admissible Power and Digital Filtering Algorithm Development of Discretely Regulated Autonomous Induction Generators
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Autonomous induction generators have such advantages as simplicity of design and high reliability. For a number of generators based on general industrial induction motors, their admissible capacities were determined according to the criterion of permissible thermal load of the stator winding. A digital filtering algorithm was developed for discrete adjustment of the capacitance of the excitation system under the conditions of stochastic load, which allows to avoid rattling of contacts at switching points.

articleTitle: Ontology Formation of Support System for Restoration of Buildings, Property and Infrastructure Objects
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The work is aimed at fulfilling set of tasks that arose on the territory of Ukraine as result of large-scale destruction caused by the armed aggression of russian federation. The functioning of computerized support system for prose’s restoration of buildings, property and infrastructure objects, which is being developed for wide range of users, is described. The structure of the ontology creation system and fragment of the table with data from which knowledge is extracted are given. Data for such ontology concepts as “expert”, opinion “damage” and “weapon type” has been formalized. It has proposed to use fuzzy associative rules to modeling the production activity of experts into process of formation conclusions about the influence of specific weapons types on the occurrence and development of specific types of destruction/damage. The perspective of using the methodology for the generation of effective building objects using information modeling of buildings and composite design of complex aggregate systems that will be restored on destroyed territories is shown.

articleTitle: Solar PV Systems Installed on Solar Blinds and Shutters to cover the DHW needs in the Mediterranean Countries
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This paper examines the possibility of using sun blinds as PV modules. A study of the influence of PV blinds on the efficiency of electricity generation, as well as on other factors affecting the efficiency of PV modules for DHW production, was conducted. Main problems considering the energy conversion and storage, quality of electricity supplied to the network and the use of energy during non-working hours (dark period of the day) was analyzed for the systems proposed in this paper. The simulation results of showed that the use of solar shutters as solar batteries in the DHW system is possible and promising. The PVsyst software was used to test the proposed system. The results of the simulation lead to the conclusion about the tangible economic effect of the idea due to the use of solar shutters with solar batteries, because if the building is correctly oriented relative to the cardinal points and there is no shadow from surrounding buildings or trees, the amount of energy converted by the shutters can fully meet the needs in DHW for 3 window apartment.

articleTitle: Irradiation System in the Hardware and Software Complex of General Phototherapy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The main principles of constructing the irradiation system of the software-hardware complex for general phototherapy have been developed in the study. This system enables therapeutic treatment of patients using electromagnetic radiation with various spectra and modulation laws of light fluxes. The design principles of individual irradiators and the arrangement of radiation sources within them are considered. Light-emitting diodes are considered as radiation sources, whose technical characteristics allow for selective effects on the human body. The results of radiation propagation modeling on the irradiated surface are presented, and an assessment of the formed therapeutic effect is provided. Principles of selective effects through the modulation of radiation intensity and wavelength are proposed.

articleTitle: Modern Applications of High-Resolution Multispectral EuroPlanet Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Remote sensing techniques, such as satellite imaging, have become vital for modern applications. The availability of acquiring high-resolution remote sensing images periodically has opened new possibilities for solving problems such as environmental analysis, climate change, and urban development. The study focuses on the performance evaluation of the EuroPlanet dataset which consists of 25,911 high-resolution multispectral satellite images and demonstrates the effectiveness of trained classifiers for land use and land cover classification. Furthermore, it was shown that the trained convolutional neural network can correctly classify the territory of Ukraine in multiple regions where manual observation is impossible due to difficult access.

articleTitle: Improved Method of Segmentation of Images From Space-Based Optoelectronic Observation Systems Based on Otsu's Algorithm with Global and Adaptive Thresholds
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: An analysis of optoelectronic image, received from space-based observation system has been carried out. It has been found out, that this image has a complex structure and a unimodal intensity histogram. Otsu method is chosen as to segment the image. This method is easy and relatively quick, when talking of its realization. Methods of global and adaptive thresholding have been researched to perform image segmentation. Results of experimental research of segmentation of optoelectronic image from space-based observation system with use of Otsu method are developed. Ways for future research in this area are defined.

articleTitle: Development of a Steam Turbine Rational Thermal Scheme for a Small Modular Reactor Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: At present, small modular reactors (SMRs) are considered as promising objects of electricity generation. NuScale multi-module light-water SMR (developer NuScale Power, USA) can be considered as the most promising for implementation in Ukraine. The aim of the article is to increase the efficiency of the NuScale SMR power plant by developing a rational thermal scheme for a steam turbine with maximum efficiency and minimal exergy losses, provided that a minimum amount of additional equipment is used. Five variants of the steam turbine thermal scheme were developed, differing in the presence/absence of a superheater in front of the low-pressure turbine and the places where the steam supplied to the superheater is taken off. The structure of each thermal scheme of the steam turbine was developed, taking into account recommendations for organizing the thermal scheme of nuclear power plants operating on saturated steam. Thermodynamic and exergy analysis showed that the most effective is the thermal scheme with steam separation, but without its intermediate overheating. By choosing this rational variant for the thermal scheme of the steam turbine, the net efficiency of the NuScale SMR power plant increased from the developers’ declared 28% to 32.23% when the steam turbine is operating at nominal mode.

articleTitle: Modeling of DC Traction Motor In Ansys RMXPRT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: DC traction motors are widely used in all branches of urban economy. They began to be used in industry about a hundred years ago with the advent of the first calculation methods. When designing a DC motor, it is important to consider it comprehensively, together with the electric drive system. The article discusses the application of a more correct approach to modeling a series-excited DC motor using the ANSYS software package, in particular, the ANSYS RMxprt / Maxwell/ Simplorer bundle. The main stages of initial data input are considered and the main calculation results are shown. Using ANSYS Maxwell allows you to quickly and automatically build a typical machine geometry using RMxprt. When solving non-standard structures, it is possible to use 3D design with step-by-step elements. The analysis of the obtained graphic dependences of electric power parameters makes it possible to judge the efficiency of the electric motor and its operational properties in idling and under load. The simulation results show excellent agreement with the data obtained experimentally.

articleTitle: "Artificial pancreas", providing the natural normal glycemic profile in the patient with DM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: It is known that the methods of traditional insulin therapy turned out to be ineffective for the stable maintenance of the glycemic profile in the patient with Diabetes mellitus (DM), inherent in a healthy person, in the range of glycemic level [72–110] mg/dl, that protect him from the development of the dangerous hypoglycemia, as well as the typical late complications of diabetes. To this dual task of insulin therapy with limitations in the chronically acceptable level of glycemia in the patient with DM to the maximum and to the minimum, a third task is added - to create the individual postprandial excesses above normoglycemia in him for providing with his glucose energy supply. It was supposed to solve this problem of fulfilling the conditions of the noted three tasks of insulin therapy by technical methods using an automatic insulin pump, which was, a priori, called an "artificial pancreas", believing that it can completely replace the physiological insulin function of the natural pancreas in a patient with DM. However, it turned out that even the most advanced modern automatic insulin pumps in reality solve only one of these tasks of insulin therapy - the inadmission of the hypoglycemia state in a patient, but cannot provide the simultaneous fulfillment of its second and third tasks: the absence of chronic hyperglycemia in him and the presence of postprandial slight exceedings above normoglycemia. Their best achievement in limiting hyperglycemia at present (as with traditional insulin therapy) is only inadmissibility of the patient's hyperglycemic level above 180 mg/dl, and only for a limited time. In this paper it was proposed the improvement of an automatic insulin pump by changing its operate system to the dynamic limits of normoglycemia, inherent in a healthy person, based on the original physiologically adequate mathematical model of glycemic dynamics. This made it possible to modify the automatic insulin pump and made it possible to solve all three noted tasks of insulin therapy on its basis, i.e. turn it into a real "artificial pancreas".

articleTitle: Second Order Difference Plot as a Tool for Low Back Pain Differentiation by Electromyographic Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Low back pain is the leading cause of the overall burden of musculoskeletal disease. Electromyography is a technique for evaluating and recording the electrical activity produced by skeletal muscles. It can be used for the diagnosis of diseases of musculoskeletal system and for assessment of the effectiveness of the treatment and rehabilitation. Electromyographic signals have extremely complex characteristics resembling a chaotic process in nature. Second order difference plot makes it possible to analyze the degree of variability or chaos in a electromyographic data set.

articleTitle: Dynamic reactive power compensation of autonomous generator set
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The article discusses the starting and loading process of an asynchronous electric motor from an autonomous generator set with simultaneous compensation of the generated reactive power by using a capacitor unit. The load reactive power measurement and the capacitors shockless switching of each phase is carried out during one period of alternating current, which improves the transient process parameters and the generated electricity quality.

articleTitle: Influence of Electrolyte Composition on Indium Phosphide Pore Geometry and Applications in Solar Energy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: In this study, we investigate the impact of electrochemical etching on the nanostructuring of Indium Phosphide (InP). The work explores the effects of electrolyte composition on the morphological and compositional properties of InP surface layers, particularly considering etching in a water solution of nitric acid and the same solution but with an addition of hydrochloric acid. The results show that InP samples etched with HCl exhibit evenly etched square pores and lower oxygen content, indicating a more controlled and anisotropic etching process.

articleTitle: Determination of the Nasal Dilators Effectiveness From Posterior Active Rhinomanometry Data During Forced Breathing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The methodology for determining the effectiveness of nasal dilators consisted of a functional study of nasal breathing - posterior active rhinomanometry with forced breathing - with the maximum possible intensity. The testing was carried out first with the use of boosters, and then (for comparison) without their use. At the same time, the measurement of pressure differences between the nasopharynx and the submask space, as well as air flow during breathing through both halves of the nose, was carried out according to the scheme of conducting posterior active rhinomanometry. Studies were conducted in the inhalation cycle. Next, the coefficient of aerodynamic nasal resistance was determined, which was calculated as the average ratio of the maximum values of the pressure drop in the respiratory cycles to the corresponding air flow. Thus, the developed rhinomanometry technique makes it possible to evaluate the effect of nasal dilators (boosters) on the aerodynamics of the nose during forced breathing during physical exercises.

articleTitle: Effects of Structural-Phase Acousto-Induced Transformations with Fractal Self-Organization for Vanadium Oxide Nanocrystals
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: For the first time, acoustic waves were used during reactive magnetron sputtering of V$O_{x}$ films to improve their structural quality. It was found that the efficiency of V$O_{x}$ synthesis depended on the modes of external ultrasound loading. The elemental-phase composition of V$O_{x}$ film surfaces was studied by XPS photoelectron spectroscopy and SEM micrographs. It was found that the quality of the film structure was improved with the additional use of ultrasound loading to the substrate during the deposition process. The XRS spectra of the samples obtained under ultrasound loading showed some narrowing of both bands (V2$p_{1/2}$ and V 2$p_{3/2}$), which was determined by the electronic structure of vanadium atoms. Improving the structure of V$O_{x}$ films under ultrasound loading was confirmed by the results of the SEM image study: for the samples obtained under the conditions of additional ultrasound loading, an arrangement and increase in grain size were observed.

articleTitle: Speed Optimization Algorithm with Refined Prediction of Jerk for Electric Drive Control System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Restrictions on intermediate coordinates contribute to the optimization of systems in terms of speed. But in most design solutions for electric drive control systems, the jerk is not a stabilized coordinate, which makes it difficult to predict motion trajectories and prevents strict optimization in the time domain. In this study, a refined jerk prediction procedure based on detailed electric drive transient diagrams is considered, the idea of which is to determine the equivalent constant jerk for power converter voltage constant intervals. With its use, an algorithm for the synthesis of a time-optimal sliding mode control system based on the N-i switching method was constructed. The efficiency of adaptation of the synthesis algorithm to different profiles of transient diagrams is demonstrated by examples of its implementation.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logic-based Software Tool for Business Process Model Complexity Assessment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The high complexity of business process models may negatively impact their quality and usability, and cause errors, costs, or even more serious damage to critical business processes when inefficient models are used. Therefore, in this study, we propose the fuzzy logic-based software tool to assess the complexity of business process models. This software tool uses the fuzzy inference system, in which rules are inferred from the existing business process model complexity metrics and their thresholds. However, the use of the fuzzy logic-based approach outperforms the existing approach based on crisp metric values and the weighted sum model by 30%, when the obtained results are compared to the expert judgment results. Fuzzy inference rules are similar to human reasoning and assume uncertain or borderline metric values by improving assessment results.

articleTitle: Theoretical Aspects of Excitation and Reception of Acoustic Waves for Non-Destructive Testing of Electromechanical and Conversion Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Ultrasonic non-destructive testing (NDT) methods are widely used due to their applicability, theoretical foundations, and availability of commercial instruments. This paper explores the use of capacitive transducers (CT) for exciting and receiving ultrasonic vibrations. While CT s are perceived to have low sensitivity compared to classical methods, experimental evidence shows their potential for confident detection. The study aims to provide a theoretical description and experimental confirmation of exciting ultrasonic vibrations through capacitive means. Paper focuses on the excitation mode, analyzing the pressure distribution and displacement of material points. Factors affecting the displacement, such as electrode area and frequency, are examined. Paper investigates the receiving mode, demonstrating the variation in capacitance and the amplitude of the output electrical signal in the CT. The results show the potential of capacitive methods in ultrasonic testing, providing insights for optimizing sensor parameters and operating modes.

articleTitle: Investigation of Analog And Spase-Vector Pulse-Width Modulation In Three-Phase Current-Source Rectifiers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The article presents a investigation of three-phase current-source rectifiers. Special analog sinusoidal pulse-width modulation algorithms with phas-shift compensation for three-phase current-source rectifier has been proposed. In the Matlab/Simulink program, a model of an current-source rectifier was developed. The processes of rectification and recuperation when applying the proposed modulation algorithm were studied. The features of the spectrum of higher harmonics of the input current are determined. It is shown that in the rectification and energy generation modes in the three-phase network, the current source rectifier implements a sinusoidal current form with a power factor greater than 0.99.

articleTitle: Analysis of Modified Non-Isolated DC-DC Converters and Solutions to Improve their Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This work presents a comparative analysis of non-isolated DC-DC converters for use in electric vehicle charging stations with photovoltaic extensions. Few groups of circuit solutions are considered: multilevel, multiphase and switched capacitors. The Three-Level “Flying” Capacitor Buck Converter was found to be the most promising topology, as it offers a reduction in the size of passive circuit elements, voltage stress and increase in efficiency compared to the other converters. Enhanced efficiency is attained by doubling the effective switching frequency, reducing the inductor voltage, and minimizing voltage stress on the semiconductors. Future research will focus on voltage balancing of flying capacitor by balancing the inductor current and developing a prototype.

articleTitle: Calculation of the Electric Field Strength on the Power Plants and Substations Territory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The electric field (EF) is one of the harmful factors affecting the working staff and people who on the territory or near operating high-voltage electric power facilities. The measurement methods have a number of disadvantages that reduce the accuracy of determining the voltage level of the EF strength. This is especially enhanced when monitoring the values of permissible levels at existing energy complexes, such as power stations and substations. The paper proposes a calculation method for determining the distribution of EF on the territory of an operating power facility using a previously developed mathematical model based on the method of equivalent charges for busbars of arbitrary configuration and implemented as a built-in module of the software LiGro v.2.0. The initial data for the calculation are the results of experimental geodetic survey work on the determination of the constructive performance of the busbar system, the location of the equipment, buildings and structures of the object. In the work, the proposed method was tested when determining the EF strength and comparing it with the maximum permissible level at the operating substation with a voltage class of 110/6 kV. The distribution pattern of the EF strength has been developed, and on the basis of normative documents, the permissible time of stay of staff in different places on the territory of the substation has been determined.

articleTitle: Ant Algorithm with Mutual Exclusion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This work investigates the possibility of using the ant algorithm to control the work of a swarm of robots in the conditions of the need for their close interaction and coordination of the movement of robots in the absence of communication between them. The main limitations for the implementation of the adapted ant algorithm were shown and ways to overcome them were proposed. By computer simulation, it has been shown that the proposed ant algorithm with mutual exclusion can be successfully used to control a swarm of robots. It is shown that in the absence of a large number of collisions, instead of the ant algorithm with mutual exclusion for modeling the behavior of a swarm of robots, in the conditions of the need for close interaction and coordination of the movement of robots in the absence of communication between them, the original adapted ant algorithm can be used.

articleTitle: Dynamics of a Conductor Free Movement Under Power Magnetic-Pulsed Action
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The dynamic of the free movement of a conductor under a force magnetic-pulse effect has been theoretically investigated. The dynamics of a conducting object in the field of magnetic-pulse forces and to numerically estimate the initial velocities of free motion (without taking into account possible resistance forces) have been analyzed. The practical significance of the results on the experimental equipment of the Kharkiv National Automobile and Highway University is shown. The results of the numerical evaluations made it possible to formulate recommendations on the choice of elements of a real electromagnetic accelerator with a high average value of the output characteristics.

articleTitle: Designing an Effective System Architecture for Detecting Propaganda and Spam in Social Media News Feed
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: In this article suggested the system architecture designed to effectively detect propaganda and spam in social media news feeds. The system is created to handle the dynamic environment of social media, with a focus on scalability, prioritization of user connections, and real-time generation of news feeds, all while maintaining low latency. In the beginning, outlined the system design of a news feed application and discussed technologies and structures in order to support user operations. To address scalability issues used a partitioning strategy and also an algorithm of offline precomputation of news feeds. The design also includes Recurrent Neural Network and Convolutional Neural Network for spam and propaganda detection trained on manually created datasets and a combination of public datasets. The approach involves asynchronously writing each post or comment into a Kafka message queue, the batching process of these messages, storing them in Amazon S3 buckets, and applying the trained neural network for detection. The overall article provides a comprehensive blueprint for an optimized and efficient system that ensures a cleaner, propaganda, and spam-free user experience in navigating social media news feeds.

articleTitle: Determining the length of an object in an X-ray image using a polynomial approximation of the segmented object’s midline
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This article presents a new approach to improving the accuracy of determining the working length in root canals using image processing and mathematical modeling methods. The proposed method offers a comprehensive non-invasive solution for root canal segmentation and analysis at the planning stage of the operation. Based on the statement, that every tooth contour in a 2D image can be found by image processing, where we get a segmented tooth. For a single-rooted tooth, the midline of the segmented image contour corresponds to the physiological location of the canal in it. This approach helps to reduce the error of the endodontist during surgery, as information about the canal bend and length is already provided. To verify the results, a comparison is made with the data obtained by electrometric measurements at the stage of surgery on the same teeth. To visualize the canal curvature, the method uses graphs that overlay the predicted calculations on the X-ray image.

articleTitle: Advisability of optimizing the nominal power scale of 110 kilovolt transformers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This study is focused on the optimization of the amount of costs for the transformation of electrical energy related to the technical and operational characteristics of power transformers. The optimization of the amount of costs is performed by finding the optimal power of the transformer for certain operating conditions. The calculation of the optimal power is based on technical and economic model of discounted costs for the transformation of electrical energy by presenting it as a function of transformers power.

articleTitle: Phase-Modulated Signals Synthesis Method to Control Information Transmission Channels
