publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The paper analyzes the methods of signal synthesis to control information transmission channels. The prospect of using phase-modulated signals to control information trans-mission channels is substantiated. Based on the results of the comparison, it is shown that the triangular law of phase change increases the reliability of monitoring the technical condition of information transmission channels. At the same time, the triangular law of phase change is technically easier to implement compared to the harmonic one. An expression is proposed for the optimal value of the phase modulation index for triangular phase modulation. The sensitivity of the tested system is calculated for the optimal phase modulation index for sinusoidal and triangular modulations. A method for synthesizing phase-modulated signals with insignificant values of the phase modulation index and high accuracy of their assignment in the low-frequency range of the envelope and non-existent is proposed. The results obtained make it possible to synthesize the optimal parameters of phase-modulated signals for monitoring information transmission channels. The results of the study are proposed to be used in communication systems when monitoring the characteristics of the reliability and validity of information transmission channels.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the Performance of a Computing Cluster Based on Single Board Raspberry Pi 3B + Computer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The article is dedicated to the problem of parallel computing on multicomputer accelerated data processing systems, namely on cluster computing systems, which consist of many independent computers and the network that connects them. The computing components of the cluster being designed are four single-board Raspberry Pi 3B+ computers. Raspbian Buster is used as the operating system for the designed cluster. The cluster system uses a SD memory card as a disk array and does not have the ability to connect nodes to the only one drive, so the topology of cluster pairs uses a distributed access topology that allows each memory disk to connect to only one cluster node. Messaging between processes is provided by the MPI interface. One of the main advantages of the cluster is the ability to scale, which, in the case of increasing computational load, leads to increased acceleration and efficiency of parallel computing. The performance of the created computing cluster based on four single-board Raspberry Pi 3B+ computers was tested on the problem implementation of the large matrices accelerated multiplication, as matrix operations are the basis of scientific and engineering calculations, and are used in mathematical modeling of various processes, phenomena and systems.

articleTitle: Client-server Mobile System for Diagnosis of Asynchronous Motors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This paper presents client-server mobile system for diagnosis of asynchronous motors. The system is created as a mobile application for smartphones and tablets. The system provides processing of the measured values of the currents and voltages of the stator phases of the asynchronous motor. According to the processing results, the results of diagnostics and forecasting of the current state of asynchronous motors are calculated. The software runs on the Android OS. The main purpose is to predict the current state of AD, which has a parametric electromagnetic asymmetry of the stator phases.

articleTitle: Determination of the Concentration of Magnetic Nanoparticles in the Biological Substance by the Acoustomagnetic Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The possibility of using acoustomagnetic influence for remote determination of the concentration of magnetic nanoparticles into local sections of the biological substance was established as a result of calculations and experimental studies in model samples of the substance.

articleTitle: Research Methodology of Emergency Surgical conditions with penetrating injuries using statistical methods.
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Considering the extreme importance of quick and reliable diagnosis of the actual condition of victims of bullet and shrapnel wounds, the issue of developing new medical technologies for this process is a very urgent task of the pre-operative period of their treatment and rehabilitation. In this sense, a new scientific approach is proposed, which is based on the use of statistical information that can be obtained from physical models of the process of passage of a penetrating object through substances that have physical properties similar to biological tissues. This work involves a comprehensive analysis of high-speed deformation and damage of a human soft tissue simulator under the penetrating impact of a firearm both by means of experimental full-scale ballistic tests and computer simulations. These studies are aimed at studying the patterns of internal wound ballistics and creating a methodology for predicting the volume of gunshot injuries for medical use.

articleTitle: Optimization of PV-system design for household
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The research deals with the design of an optimal photovoltaic system for a specific location in the Czech Republic. Commercially available different types of PV panels were installed in the selected locations for the collection of data was used Arduino platform. Optimal technical and economic recommendations were developed for the four types. The work was successful in confirming some characteristic features of these types of panels according to theoretical models. In some cases, the effect of the technical performance of the measurement and the behavior of the panel was slightly different.

articleTitle: Use Of Solar Cogeneration Modules For Charging Batteries Of Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The paper explores the problem of the possibility of creating local energy networks for charging batteries of electric vehicles at existing stationary gas stations based on renewable sources, to save energy from traditional energy sources. It is proposed to create such networks based on efficient solar power plants (SPP), which are installed on a roof of an administration building of a gas station.To substantiate the possibility of using SPPs for charging batteries of electric vehicles at a gas station, a correlation analysis of the daily load schedules of three private SPPs installed on the roofs of private buildings located next to the “WOG” gas station in Zaporizhzhia and the daily load schedules of the “WOG” gas station were carried out. Experimental daily load schedules of private SPPs and gas stations “WOG” were obtained for three working days in April 2023. Pearson’s pair correlation coefficients for the light day between equivalent daily load schedules of rooftop SPPs and daily load schedules of “WOG” gas stations were determined, which have high values, that is, we have a high correlation. The conducted research made it possible to conclude the possibility of using rooftop SPPs for charging batteries of electric cars at stationary gas stations.To increase the overall efficiency of SPPs, instead of traditional flat solar cells, it is proposed to use SPPs with cogeneration photovoltaic modules of cylindrical shape cooled by liquid. This will make it possible to obtain electric and thermal energy for economic needs at the same time.The obtained values of Pearson’s pair correlation coefficients of daily load schedules SPPs and gas stations have high values, which makes it possible to assert the possibility of using SPPs at gas stations to charge batteries of electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Condition Monitoring and Fault Diagnosis Systems of Power Generators with Non-Contact Shaft Runout Electrocapacitive Transducer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: In the paper condition monitoring and fault diagnosis systems structure with electrocapacitive transducer is considered. To improve the efficiency and accuracy of defect identification, the system showed the need to use data from noncontact shaft runout sensors. To reduce the influence of external fields and non-uniformity of equipotential lines on the response characteristic of the electrocapacitive sensor, is substantiated the necessity of using a guard electrode in the form of a Kelvin ring. Secondary measuring transducer has been developed for a capacitive sensor with a Kelvin guard electrode. And designed to measure runout of shaft in powerful hydrogenerators. Secondary measuring transducer in proximity to the sensor electrodes, in order to eliminate the influence of parasitic capacitance, through a connecting triaxial cable between the sensor and the secondary transducer is proposed. Presented the results of experimental tests of the sample shaft runout electrocapacitive transducer for condition monitoring and fault diagnosis systems. It is shown that the shaft runout electrocapacitive transducer provides a measurement error of no more than 0.2–0.5% of the measurement range.

articleTitle: Optimization of Multivariable Technological Systems’ Automatic Control based on Stability Criteria
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The work is dedicated to the investigation of optimal functioning of automated control systems for multivariable technological objects and corresponding stability criteria under rapidly changing loads. This is a relevant scientific and technical task that allows ensuring their reliable operation in the presence of probable inconsistencies between parameters of different physical nature. Mathematical and computer models have been developed to determine optimal stability criteria for control systems of multi-parameter technological objects and ensure directive operating modes for the object’s executive mechanisms. The congruence between the simulation results and the theoretical and engineering calculations demonstrates the effectiveness of determining stability criteria and the consistency between the corresponding microprocessor and software tools of the automatic control systems.

articleTitle: Justification of the organizational readiness of industrial enterprises for technological changes using fuzzy logic
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The paper addresses the problem of defining the priority of investment support for innovation and technological changes among multiple competing entities in the industrial sector of the national economy. It emphasizes that technological changes should be implemented taking into account the organizational readiness of enterprises to effectively utilize new technologies. The author’s position is expressed, stating that the criteria for organizational readiness for innovation and technological changes are the effectiveness of innovation management processes and quality management, which collectively ensure the enterprise’s ability to create new consumer values and maintain the established parameters of consumer value, according to which it is positioned in the market. Considering the fact that these criteria are multi-component and cannot be clearly quantified, methodological approaches of fuzzy logic were used to assess the totality of their states and the dispersion parameters of individual indicators were determined. Approbation of the author’s development was carried out for a number of machine-building enterprises of the Podillia region, which are direct competitors on the local market. The calculations confirmed the legality of this approach and its practical applicability, including for machine-building enterprises of the electrical engineering industry.

articleTitle: Relationship Between Digitalization and Living Standards in European Union Countries
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The purpose of this article is to determine the relationship between digitalization and living standards in individual countries of the European Union. To assess the level of digitalization, the Digital Economy and Society Index (DESI) is used. Based on the analysis of the index for 2022, two groups of countries were identified. The first group included 14 countries with high rates of digital development. The second group is represented by 13 countries with digital indicators below the average for the European Union. The paper proposes a hypothesis about the presence of a positive correlation between digitalization and the standard of living of the population. To test the hypothesis, a correlation-regression analysis was carried out using indicators of digitalization and an indicator of the relative standard of living of the population for 2017–2022 in six countries selected from two different groups. Based on the results of the analysis, the presence of a direct relationship between digitalization and the standard of living of the population was confirmed. At the same time, a different degree of influence of factors characterizing digitalization on the standard of living in European Union countries has been established. The center of growth in countries with a high Digital Economy and Society Index lies in the increase in the network and the speed of information transfer. In countries with a lower level of digitalization, the center of growth is the integration of digital technologies. In addition, it was found that the correlation between the analyzed indicators is stronger in countries with a high level of digitalization, such as Finland, Denmark, and the Netherlands. The paper also provides a justification for the need to implement intelligent digital devices, considering the influence of the energy factor on the standard of living of the population.

articleTitle: Technology of Electrochemiluminescence Sensors Based on Langmuir-Blodgett Films with Polycyclic Organic Phosphors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This work is devoted to the description of the methodology for depositing polymethyl methacrylate (PMMA) films with the incorporated phosphor 9,10-diphenylanthracene (DPA) using the Langmuir-Blodgett technique on the surface of ITO electrodes for electrochemiluminescence (ECL) analysis, studying the physicochemical properties of the obtained sensors and their analytical properties in an aqueous solution of sodium tetraphenylborate $(\mathrm{P}\mathrm{h}_{4}\mathrm{B}\mathrm{N}\mathrm{a})$ coreactant as a model analyte. The methodology for the preparation of solutions describes in detail the most optimal techniques and justifies the necessity of using ultrasonic processing and fixanals. The results of the ECL analysis of aqueous solutions of Ph4BNa show a linear dependence of the maximum intensity of the ECL signal on the negative logarithm of the Ph4BNa concentration in the range of 1$\times 10^{-6}\div 1\times 10^{-3}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{o}1/\mathrm{L}$.

articleTitle: Bayesian Network as a Decision Support System in the Company’s Risk Management System of Emergency Situations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Emergencies can inflict not only irreparable harm to individuals but also to a company’s operations. If we can foresee the onset of intricate emergency situations with catastrophic outcomes, we then have the chance to reduce these repercussions through the implementation of tailored risk management measures, safeguarding the company’s activities. Traditional methods of modeling and forecasting complex (extraordinary) natural processes do not yield dependable data for constructing viable scenarios in the analysis of strategies or making informed management decisions. Therefore, in the study, the authors proposed a scientific-methodical approach to the preventive orientation of risk management of emergencies of a company, which is improved by an oriented acyclic graph of the Bayesian network, which gives the posterior probability as a result and, unlike others, takes into account the causality of emergency events of the company. An algorithm for constructing a Bayesian network with a directed acyclic graph using the Netica software product is proposed. This tool - an acyclic graph of the Bayesian network - gives a posterior probability as a result and, unlike others, provides variability in the assessment of the impact of factors and considers the causality of a company’s extraordinary events. Approbation of the developed methodological and analytical toolkit proved its real nature. Modeling can be approached in both traditional “top-down” and “bottom-up” methods, depending on whether you start with pre-established model characteristics or build the model from the ground up. A deeper understanding of the occurrence and progression of emergencies, as well as the factors triggering their activation, can assist companies in devising management strategies that increase the likelihood of attaining and sustaining a healthy ecosystem. Conventional methods for modeling and forecasting complex (extraordinary) natural processes do not yield dependable data for creating viable scenarios when analyzing strategies and making informed management decisions. The article’s significance lies in its practical contribution to emergency risk management through Bayesian networks and its novelty in introducing a preventive approach tailored to specific emergency scenarios in companies. Additionally, it emphasizes the broader applicability of Bayesian networks.

articleTitle: Application of Air Gap Sensor for Improved Fault Detection and Diagnostics Tools for Hydrogenerators Condition Monitoring Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: In the paper a present results, which are devoted to the system of monitoring the technical condition and the process of detecting defects of the hydrogenerator based on the control of mechanical defects with air gap sensor. A description of the operation of defect identification tools based on the identification of their characteristics is given. Application of the methods is impossible without the construction of appropriate mathematical models that reflect in detail the main physical processes occurring in the power equipment or in its separate structural unit. The structure of the technical condition control system with additional air gap sensors is given. The development of an air gap sensor for the control system is considered. The use of air gap sensors in the structure of the control system for measuring the parameters of mechanical defects, which allows detecting machine defects at an earlier stage of their development.

articleTitle: Analysis Of Current Approaches to Modernizing the Electric Power Scheme of Diesel Generator Transport
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The work is devoted to the analysis of modern approaches to modernisation of the scheme of power supply of diesel-generator transport and on this basis to the description of the optimal design of such a system. The aim of the work is to analyse modern approaches to modernisation of the scheme of power supply of diesel-generator transport and to develop an energy-efficient structure of such a system. The object of the study is the design of the traction power transmission of a diesel train. The subject of the study is the control system of traction power transmission of diesel trains. The above task of designing an upgraded automatic control system is the main part of the overall task of improving the efficiency of traction power transmission of a diesel train. The paper shows that the synthesized automatic control system should be optimized according to certain principles. In particular, the parametric principle is taken into account, according to which with the chosen structure of the control system and the known functional influences on the traction power transmission such parameters are defined, at which the given quality indicators of transients (indicators of traction inverter operation) are satisfied; the structural principle, according to which the system is designed so that it contains the minimum necessary number of elements, easily physically realized for full operation, is taken into account; functional principle is taken into account, according to which the control laws, and according to them the structure and numerical values of the parameters of the control system are determined. As a result, an upgraded control system of the diesel train traction axle on the basis of subordinate control systems without a speed sensor is developed and substantiated, which allows the movement of a diesel train with a given torque or speed, as well as provides the ability to move the diesel train when the general system fails. control of movement.

articleTitle: Optimisation of Operating Modes of Distribution Electric Networks in Ukraine
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The article considers the peculiarities of structure and functioning of distribution electric networks of Ukraine. A criterion for optimising the modes of distribution electric networks is proposed, which takes into account the nature of load changes, peculiarities of voltage regulation in electric networks, as well as the presence of distributed generation sources in the network. For the studied 10 kV electric network, measures have been developed to ensure the conditions for optimising operating modes. An algorithm is developed to select the most appropriate of the developed measures, which takes into account the current situation of development of electric networks, current trends and prospects for the development of technical means, automation systems and intelligent control systems for electric network modes.

articleTitle: Fluid-filled Shell Structures and Their Applications in Biomechanics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Structures in the form of thin-walled shells containing liquid are extremely common in various areas of modern technology, as oil storage facilities, water towers, rocket launch tanks and manifolds for storing chemicals. Failure of such structures is fraught with a wide range of negative consequences. The problems of fluid-structure interaction of structural elements partially filled with liquids, are in the focus of many research since the 60s of last century. The growing interest in biological materials and medicine has also accentuated the importance of studying the dynamical behavior of shell-like structures with fluids. In this paper, effective numerical methods to estimate the frequencies and modes of elastic shell vibrations coupled with liquid sloshing are elaborated. The approach is relied on using the mode superposition method as well as boundary and finite element methods. The problem under consideration consists of three stages. At first, it is necessary to obtain the frequencies and modes of empty elastic shell, at second stage the sloshing modes and frequencies are received. At third stage and modes and frequencies of elastic shell vibrations coupled with liquid sloshing are obtained. Own modes and frequencies of spherical and conical steel shells are estimated, as well as modes and frequencies of eardrum interacting with liquids. The influence of impact loads on the tympanic membrane is analyzed.

articleTitle: Neural Network Method for Helicopters Turboshaft Engines Dynamic Efficiency Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The work is devoted to the development of a neural network method for monitoring the dynamics of changes in the efficiency of the engine compressor, which characterizes the efficiency of air compression in the compressor and, as a result, ultimately determines the fuel consumption, which affects the helicopter flight. The use of the neural network ensemble “RBF – Perceptron – Neuro-Fuzzy Classifier” is proposed, which allows to determine the current engine status with an accuracy of 99.62 % and quickly decide on the possibility of carrying out (continuing) the flight. The results of a comparative analysis with other neural networks architectures showed that the use of the neural network ensemble “RBF – Perceptron –Neuro-Fuzzy Classifier” provides a decrease in errors of the first and second kind from 1.23 to 5.96 times.

articleTitle: Unlocking the Potential Under Ageing Labor Force and Digitalization Challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This study examines the challenges and opportunities pushed by digitalization under the ageing labor force trend. We observe a rise in labor force participation among individuals aged 55-64 in the European Union and Ukraine, but age discrimination remains a barrier. Digitalization is reshaping the labor market, creating a demand for digital skills. However, there are disparities in digital proficiency among different age groups. Bridging the digital gap is crucial for empowering labor market. Continuous skills development and retraining initiatives are needed to address the challenges faced by older workers. Generative AI technologies can play a vital role in facilitating their adaptation. This study emphasizes the need for comprehensive support and lifelong learning for an inclusive and sustainable labor market.

articleTitle: Adaptable Solar Cells Relying on CdS/CdTe Heterosystem for Photovoltaic Thermal Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The main goal is to create a basic solution for a pliable, thin-film PVC that utilizes the $\mathrm{CdS} / \mathrm{CdTe}$ heterosystem modified to suit specific needs for mounting a solar panel from some photovoltaic converter directly to the heat collector plate as part of A self-sufficient integrated photovoltaic system designed for both military and civilian purposes, utilizing conventional solar thermal collectors, forms basis of such type systems. The central element of this setup is a photo generating unit, consisting of a typical solar water heating collector on frontal panel of which the flexible solar battery from $\mathrm{CdS} / \mathrm{CdTe}$ photovoltaic converters is installed. Research findings indicate that a flexible photovoltaic converter employing cadmium telluride exhibits a excellent absorption of sunlight within the $400-800 \mathrm{~nm}$, ranging from $94 \%$ to $96 \%$. Moreover, the reflectance of long wave part of sunlight remains below $8 \%$, leads to simplify system constructive, because film photoelectric converter work as absorber with selective coating. The calculation of the thermal conductivity of flexible photovoltaic converters based on cadmium telluride, experiments conducted on a $7 \mu \mathrm{m}$ thick polyimide film demonstrated that considering the thermal conductivity coefficient of polyimide, ranging from 0.14 to $0.20 \mathrm{~W} /(\mathrm{m} \cdot \mathrm{K})$, it is feasible to achieve a heat gradient in a such photovoltaic converter in the range of $0.6-0.9^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Analysis of Fluid Vibrations in Liquid Storage Tanks under Wind Loads
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The paper is devoted to Aeolian liquid vibrations in reservoirs caused by low-velocity, steady winds. Amplitudes and dominant frequencies of the wind load are constantly changing, so fuzzy logic methods are the most suitable mathematical apparatus for describing the problem. It is supposed that the load amplitudes and frequencies are characterized by fuzzy numbers. At first stage the solution of the crisp initial value problem is obtained. A cylindrical rigid thin-walled shell is used as the tank model. The considered ideal fluid is assumed to be incompressible, and its motion is potential. These suppositions make it possible to provide the potential of velocities, which, as a result of the above assumptions, satisfies the Laplace equation. At the rigid boundaries of the liquid volume, the conditions of non-flow are satisfied, and the free surface is subjected to kinematic and dynamic boundary conditions. First, a crisp boundary value problem is solved, which is reduced to a system of differential equations, then the initial data and loading parameters are fuzzified using triangular fuzzy numbers. Finally, the analysis of the numerical solution of the fuzzy boundary value problem is carried out.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Energy Efficiency of Geometric Constructions Solar Low-power Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The purpose of the research is to determine the dependence of the energy efficiency of low-power solar power plants on the peculiarities of their construction, made in the form of geometric structures. The research was carried out using the theory of analytical calculations and mathematical modelling of electricity generation processes at solar power plants with consideration of climatic indicators. The article considers the issues of peculiarities of construction of low-power photovoltaic power plants when combining solar panels into different geometric structures in order to identify the most productive option. An analysis of the general indicators and factors influencing the productivity of electricity generation by solar panels is carried out and the most significant ones are identified, which should be taken into account when geometrising structures. A comparative analysis of the geometric structures of the solar panel combination is carried out and recommendations are made on the feasibility of using the considered samples in order to increase the reliability and energy efficiency of electricity supply to consumers. A mathematical model of a solar power plant has been developed, which is as close as possible to real operating conditions due to the consideration of such factors influencing its energy efficiency as the level of solar insolation, the angle of inclination of the PV modules, the surface area of the PV modules, the heating temperature of the panel surface, and the level of panel shading. The use of the proposed mathematical model made it possible to compare the operating parameters of low-power solar power plants of the considered geometric structures, which proved the higher performance of the solar power plant made in the form of a multifaceted pyramid.

articleTitle: Interval Modeling and Simulation of Duffing Pendulum
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The paper deals with the development of a theoretical framework to design interval piece-wise linear models of nonlinear plants. These models are implemented in continuous and discrete time domains by using the generalized transfer functions. The above-mentioned transfer functions can be considered as the generalized differential or difference matrix operator. We use these operators to define free, controlled, and perturbed motions for the considered plant. Components of the considered matrix operators are defined according to strong mathematical backgrounds and have formalized forms. Interval methods are applied to the considered differential operators to increase the sphere of their usage and consider not only the motion of dynamical plants with exactly known parameters but motions with minimal and maximal combinations of these parameters as well. Also, the use of interval methods allows us to define domains where the nonlinear function is defined. We consider the square of these domains as the energy that one should supply to the plant to perform compensation for its nonlinearity. To reduce this energy and design energy efficient control system we offer to minimize the square of the above-mentioned domain by using piece-wise linear functions to define its boundaries. These piecewise linear boundaries are defined with sets of factors whose members depend on current values of plant state variables and define piece-wise continuous transfer functions components for motions on plant boundaries.

Author Keywords: integral transform with non-zero initial conditions
continuous and discrete time transfer functions

articleTitle: Determination of a Line with a Single-Phase Short Circuit in the Distribution Network Using the Method of Signal Input
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: A distribution network with a mode of small ground fault currents can provide high reliability of power, but with a single-phase ground closure, it is quite difficult to determine the damaged line. In distribution networks, most of the damage is single-phase ground closures. For the normal operation of the network, it is quite important to quickly and accurately determine the line with the ground fault. This article proposes a method for determining a damaged line based on the signal line. The dynamic selection of parameters and frequency of the signal supplied to the network, which is analyzed by this method in real time, is analyzed. The accuracy of signal conversion in the frequency region is improved by using the Fourier phase transformation. Considering the active energy consumption of the entered signal after damage as a criterion improves the accuracy of the line determination. Theoretical analysis has shown that the damaged line can be determined quite accurately.

articleTitle: Finite Element Study of Biomechanical Behavior of Short Dental Implants with Bone Loss Effects – Evaluation of Bone Turnover
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Contemporary dental implantology is, in essence, the outcome of advanced biomechanical engineering, particularly in addressing the challenge of inadequate bone quality and quantity in the posterior maxilla through the use of short implants. Their effectiveness depends on various factors, including the design, the quality of the patient’s bone, and the level of marginal bone loss. These factors ultimately influence how the functional load is transferred to the surrounding bone. The primary objective of our study was to assess the impact of the design and diameter of short plateau implants on the strain magnitudes experienced by the adjacent bone in cases where bone loss is a clinical concern. This evaluation aimed to provide insights into the prognosis of these implants, in terms of whether they contribute to healthy or pathological bone turnover. The study was focused on the assessment of the first principal strains (FPSs) within the contacting bone tissue to gauge the bone turnover surrounding three Bicon SHORT® implants with diameters of 4.5, 5.0, and 6.0 mm, and a length of 5.0 mm. These implants were tested across a range of bone loss levels, from 0.2 to 1.0 mm. 3D models of these implants were placed crestally in corresponding models of the posterior maxilla with type III bone characteristics and 1.0 mm thick crestal and sinus cortical bone layers. These models were subjected to a mean oblique load of 120.92 N, applied to the center of a 7. The analysis was focused on the maximal FPSs observed in the bone tissue. To evaluate the physiological or pathological bone turnover in adjacent area, we correlated maximal FPSs with a minimum effective strain threshold of 3000 μstrain (MESp) according to Frost. In cases of completely osseointegrated implants, the maximal FPSs ranged from 2000 to 3170 μstrain, were located in vicinity of the cortical/cancellous bone boundary, specifically at the first fin edge. In cases where bone loss was present, these maximal FPSs still occurred at the same location and were significantly influenced by the level of bone loss ((2120…3620, 2300…4180, 2500…4810, 2700…5520 and 2990…6400 μstrain for 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 and 1.0 mm bone loss). The implant diameter played a substantial role in determining the maximal FPSs. Increasing the implant diameter from 4.5 to 6.0 mm resulted in a reduction in FPS by 41%, 45%, 48%, 51%, and 53% for bone loss levels of 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0 mm, respectively, in comparison to completely osseointegrated implants. N implant exhibited a significant increase of FPS at all studied levels of bone loss (14…102)%, rendering them unsuitable for type III bone due to FPS exceeding the 3000 μstrain threshold even for completely osseointegrated implants. W implant demonstrated (6…39)% of FPS increase but totally positive bone turnover across the range of bone loss levels, while M implant with (15…109)% of FPS increase only demonstrated this effect for bone loss up to 0.2 mm. These findings have important implications for implant manufacturers seeking to design more effective implants. Clinicians should also consider these results as valuable guidelines when working with short plateau implants in clinical practice.

articleTitle: Prosuming Business Models in Transition to a Sustainable Bioeconomy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The development and implementation of innovative business models in the energy sector and their integration into the production processes of the industrial sector for the creation of highly productive and cost-effective production facilities is an important prerequisite for the successful bio-economic transformation of industries and the creation of added value and benefit for the consumer. Such integration is expected to lead to positive developments in strategic sectors of the economy, mainly related to energy security, by gradually reducing dependence on fossil fuels and mitigating environmental problems such as global warming and toxic waste and emissions. The transition from a traditional economy to a bioeconomy requires adapting the way of energy production and consumption. The introduction of energy prosuming models will help radically change the energy system, as it allows to reduce the cost of electricity, which can serve as an economic and environmental stimulus for the bio-economic transformation of the national economy, but on the other hand, it can create problems for traditional energy producers and power grid operators. The purpose of this study is to analyze the prospects for the introduction of innovative business models in energy, such as prosuming, energy cooperation, green energy storage systems, etc., and their impact on the development of the bioeconomy. To achieve the goal, an analysis of the dynamics of changes and trends in the EU energy market and their impact on bio-economic transformations was carried out. The main problems and issues for the widespread introduction of renewable energy sources in Ukraine were identified and innovative business models for the development of alternative energy in modern conditions were investigated. A dynamic model of the bio-economic transformation of industries by stimulating Self-Consumption Energy Cooperatives has been developed, and the main directions of regulatory and financial support for prosumerism in Ukraine have been determined based on world experience.

articleTitle: A Novel Method of Load Bearing Ability Analysis of Short Plateau Implants Placed in Compromised Bone
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Atrophy of the alveolar crest in the posterior maxilla is related to lower implant survival rates. The problem is exacerbated by clinically occurring thin cortical bone. FEM allows to simulate adequately biomechanical properties of the bone-implant interface with their wide scattering and dependence on age, sex, etc. The method is suitable for evaluating the effect of the maxilla cortical bone elasticity and quality as well as implant diameter on its bearing ability. The aim was to evaluate bone stress magnitudes and introduce innovative indices of implant load-bearing capacity to assess bone capability to successfully withstand functional loading under poor bone quality conditions. 3D models of osseo-integrated implants placed crestally in type III/IV bone, were analyzed in FEM with cortical bone variable elasticity modulus and ultimate strength. Maximal von Mises stresses in surrounding bone were calculated and compared with patient-specific cortical bone ultimate strength to determine the implant index of load-bearing capacity. Its value was influenced by implant diameter, cortical bone elasticity and bone quality.

articleTitle: Forecasting Breakdowns of Electric Motors of a Sugar Factory Using Machine Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: the paper demonstrates the process of developing mathematical models for identifying breakdowns of electric motors using machine learning methods. The authors have developed three mathematical models for identifying breakdowns of electric drives with a power of 55 kW, 1500 rpm on the example of sugar production: model for quadratic discriminant analysis; binary classification decision tree; feed-forward neural network model. The best structures and parameters of the models were determined by machine learning methods. The performance of the models on the training and test sets was more than 96% by F-score. It was proposed to use all three models independently for diagnosing breakdowns of electric drives, while the decision maker makes the final decision on the replacement or repair of electrical equipment. This approach is justified and effective because of the diversity of models. The developed models, except for assessing the state of the engine, can also be used for simulation modelling, forecasting, and serve as information support for process operators in organizing equipment maintenance. The availability of real-time information about the state of equipment in production will allow timely repair or replacement of equipment, thereby reducing the risks of stopping production and increasing the resource efficiency of technological processes.

articleTitle: Industry 4.0 Technology Foresight in Electrical Engineering Sector
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: In the era of Industry 4.0, technological disruptions are transforming traditional sectors, including electrical engineering. The urgency to adapt and evolve has made technology foresight an essential tool for organizational resilience. This study investigates how such foresight is operationalized by examining selected multinational corporations such as Siemens, General Electric, and Ericsson, along with multinational innovation ecosystems like the European Research Area and the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers. These entities represent cornerstone examples of how technology foresight in the context of Industry 4.0 is shaping the future of the electrical engineering sector. Our findings reveal distinct but complementary approaches between corporate and ecosystem-based foresight, each filling gaps the other may not cover. These leading entities not only guide their own strategic directions but also influence the broader professional community, shaping R& D decisions and innovation strategies in the electrical engineering field. Their combined efforts offer a more nuanced and actionable roadmap for navigating the complex landscape ushered in by Industry 4.0.

articleTitle: The Motivational Model for Improvement of Electricity Supply Continuity in Post-War Ukraine
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The motivational model for increase of power supply reliability, which takes into account a technical condition of the equipment of distributive networks of territorial subdivisions of Distribution Systems Operators and the level of implementation of the investment plan of the maintenance, the overhaul, the reconstruction or equipment replacement through its technical condition is offered. Major factor of influence in this motivational model is the System Average Interruption Duration Index owing to technological infringements in electric networks. The analysis of results of activity of territorial subdivisions of Distribution Systems Operators is based on comparison of target value and actual value of a System Average Interruption Duration Index for each territorial subdivision. It is proposed at definition of target value of a System Average Interruption Duration Index, on which the result of activity of territorial subdivisions in previous year is analyzed, to consider a technical condition of the equipment of distributive networks in the beginning of activity which analyzes. Also at the same time to take into account the level of implementation of the investment plan of the maintenance, the overhaul, the reconstruction or equipment replacement through its technical condition is proposed. Conditions for definition of stimulation factor for achievement of the best results of activity of territorial subdivisions of Distribution Systems Operators according to a subdivisions rating by the difference between actual value and target value of a System Average Interruption Duration Index or in direct ratio to a rating, or proportionally of reliability level reached are formulated.

articleTitle: The Improved Voltage Control Relay For The Single-phase Household Consumers Protection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This paper examines a novel approach for both the single-phase voltage control relays circuit design and work algorithms that are used for protection of the household consumers of electrical energy from unacceptable voltage deviations within power supply network. An overview, analysis and description of the circuit design elements, operation algorithms, methods of voltage measurements and the thresholds settings of the modified voltage control relays, based on microprocessors and microcontrollers have been carried out. The conducted overview and analysis systematizes information on the technical and functional features of the operational algorithms, circuits and components of the mentioned relays and demonstrates the prospects for development of voltage relay operational algorithms and protective characteristics according to existing International standards. The protective characteristics and standards of the power quality have been outlined and illustrated by the authors in detail. The voltage measuring and digital signal processing (signal filtering) algorithms in modified voltage relay are described as well.A generalization and conclusion are made concerning the improved operation algorithm in the voltage control relay for protection of single-phase household consumers. This paper might be useful for the specialists in this or similar subject area, for instance investigations of protective voltage relays for industrial applications.

articleTitle: Women’s Small Businesses Development in the Post-War Period in Ukraine: Non-Conventional Industry Sectors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This article is dediced to tools for women’s small businesses development in the post-war period of Ukraine in atypical industries for women. The authors suggest using new approaches to the design of women’s small businesses in combination with business cooperation strategies, electronic governance by artificial intelligence in social networks because of the electrical engineering sector development on the basis of distributed production. It is proposed to create a hub for women entrepreneurs on the basis of the Department of Public Management and Administration, where they can exchange their ideas; to take courses for female aspiring entrepreneurs; to discuss their ideas with the leadership representatives of territorial communities.

articleTitle: Regulatory and Legal Trends in the Transfer of Dual-purpose Technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The analysis of regulatory and legal trends transfer of dual-purpose technologies (including electronics) in the global economy was carried out. Proposals have been formulated to improve the effectiveness of the basic regulatory provisions related to the export control of dual-purpose technologies in accordance with the current legislation of Ukraine. The research results can serve as a basis for comparing and analyzing current differentiated policies for the commercialization of dual-use technologies, as well as for establishing an emergent institutional order in this area.

Author Keywords: export control of technologies and dual-use goods

articleTitle: Networked ZnO nanosheets produced by automatic SILAR method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: In this work, we have developed an automatic low temperature, cheap, simple and scalable chemical method Successive Ionic Layer Adsorption and Reaction (SILAR) to obtain layers of two-dimensional zinc oxide (ZnO) nanostructures from aqueous solutions. The ZnO networked nanosheets obtained by the automatic SILAR method have high adhesion to the glass substrate and improved mechanical resistance, which was confirmed by scratch adhesion tests performed by applying a progressive load. The value of the normal force Fz = 2.6 N, corresponding to the critical load Lc, for networked ZnO nanosheets is greater than for a conventional array of ZnO nanorods, for which Fz = 2.1 N.

articleTitle: Simulating Strategies for Mitigating the Impact of the Energy Crisis on Small-Scale Businesses
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The military invasion of Ukraine has significantly impacted the global energy market. The provoked energy crisis has posed considerable challenges to the economies of many EU countries and the wider world, with small businesses experiencing the most pronounced effects. Amid the acute phase of power outages, the survival of small businesses emerged as a critical concern. Escalating energy prices have led to strategic dilemmas for numerous companies. The paper considers various response strategies of small businesses to the energy crisis, specifically exploiting alternative electricity sources. The trend and the range of optimality for each scenario have been determined, including using standalone gasoline or diesel generators, battery energy storage systems, and installing solar panel power stations. The ownership costs for each alternative over five years, and the consideration of each solution’s life cycle have been calculated. The payback period for a hypothetical small business enterprise in Ukraine has also been projected. The study’s informational foundation was drawn from the experiences of small businesses during the energy collapse in Ukraine. The study resulted in a substantiated, effective method for overcoming energy challenges during wartime. The proposed approach can be employed to rationalize strategies for ensuring the energy security of a broad array of small businesses.

articleTitle: Implementation Of Neural Network Diagnostics Of Agile Management For Ensuring Economic Security Of The Organization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: In order to avoid threats and risks in enterprise activity, it is possible to use a probabilistic neural network, which will contribute to economic security and effective management decisions. A probabilistic neural network is a mathematical object that implements a three-step computational procedure. This procedure takes place on the input, radial and output layers of the neural network. The article proposes an agile control system based on a two-component neural network diagnosis, which contains a feedback that will contribute to the development of the control system. The implementation of the proposed approach is tested on the example of a specific enterprise, with the presentation of numerical estimates, determined on the basis of expert evaluation (expert judgments). The signs and degrees of threats to the economic security of the researched enterprise are determined and the corresponding lists of management decisions for their weakening are presented. The input matrix and matrices for different degrees (weak, medium and strong) of the threat to the investigated enterprise are given. Neural network diagnostics for flexible control was performed monthly at the researched enterprise by 14 experts with the presentation of all vector estimates submitted to the input of two neural networks, respectively - the first - using the built-in Matlabfunction “newpnn”, which receives at the input matrix functions, the second-the decisive probabilistic neural network in which we use the same parameter of the scatter of radial basis functions.

articleTitle: Formation of Metallurgy Industry Development Scenarios Based on Energy Efficiency and Digitalization of Production
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This paper substantiates the energy efficiency and digitization of production when forming scenarios for the development of the metallurgical industry, and proposes integrated solutions for optimizing energy consumption in industrial systems. The paper presents three development scenarios for the metallurgy industry, assessing economic and environmental factors. These factors, including energy efficiency and digitalization of production, are important can increase the industry's competitive advantage by increasing efficiency and reducing waste. The study constructed an “Energy-Metallurgy: Production-Consumption” diagram and it was founded that certain energy-efficient technologies are successfully used in the steel industry, including high-efficiency furnaces, waste heat recovery systems, and advanced control systems. The article emphasizes that these technologies can significantly reduce energy consumption and improve the environmental performance of the industry. Analysis of the feedback diagram of the components of the "Energymetallurgy: production-consumption" system provides grounds for the development of strategic scenarios regarding the ways of mutual support of the two largest economic sectors of Ukraine - metallurgy and energy. The implementation of energy-efficient technologies in the steel industry is also expected to promote innovation and improve competitiveness. Companies that invest in energy-efficient technologies can differentiate themselves from their competitors, leading to increased market share and increased revenue.

articleTitle: Institutional Factors of the Appropriateness of Facilitating the Implementation of Promising Technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: In this work, the institutional factors of the appropriateness of the formation of an institutional environment, which contributes to the accelerated implementation of promising technologies, are determined, using the example of video surveillance cameras with the function of facial recognition. It was proved that the successful introduction of new technologies requires not only the formation of a favorable institutional environment, but also the creation of conditions for their effective and unquestionable application. The criteria for the effectiveness of the formation of a favorable institutional environment for the accelerated implementation of video surveillance cameras with the function of facial recognition have been determined. Measures aimed at eliminating factors that facilitate unauthorized access to the network of video surveillance cameras with the function of facial recognition are proposed.

articleTitle: Technology of Webpages Development to Support Accessibility Requirements for Blind People Using NVDA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The work deals with issues that are relevant for developers of websites and web applications to support users with certain disabilities who access the Internet via desktop computers or laptops using screen reader NVDA. The core users of NVDA are blind people. The effectiveness of using the application depends on the quality and completeness of the description of the web page tags. The purpose of the research is to ensure the appropriate level of accessibility of web pages that will be used by blind users using NVDA. Formalized rules for analyzing structure of webpages in the form of predicates calculus have formed. The proposed technology for developing webpages and web applications has been presented in the form of BPMN business process diagrams. Approach for automated detection of problematic tags in the structure of webpages has considered. Several webpages with identical design and different web-structure have been researched for checking accessibility requirements for blind people. The results of webpage accessibility estimation and the corresponding screenshots that visualize problematic situations in the work of blind users with a webpage have presented.

articleTitle: Connection CdS/CdTe Based Photovoltaic Converters in Micromodules
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This article explores the challenges in producing efficient thin-film photovoltaic converters based on cadmium telluride (CdTe) and proposes potential solutions to improve their performance and reduce production costs. The existing production technologies for CdTe converters struggle to compete with poly and single-crystal silicon converters due to scalability issues. The study investigates the possibility of combining small-area CdTe converters into micromodules, which can leverage high-tech production methods and lower costs. Additionally, the article suggests equipping these converters with hybrid thermal photo energy systems to compensate for the lower efficiency of CdTe converters. Experimental samples of flexible PVC/CdS/CdTe/Cu/Au converters are manufactured using various deposition techniques, and their structural and optical characteristics are analyzed. The article also discusses the connection of solar cells in micromodules and compares the performance of parallel and serial connections. Theoretical and experimental evaluations of the micromodules’ output parameters, such as short-circuit current, open circuit voltage, and efficiency, are presented. The results indicate that serial connections yield better performance, and the article discusses the reasons behind the discrepancies between theoretical and experimental efficiency values. Finally, the manufacturing and research of PVC micromodules on flexible substrates are explored, focusing on the geometry of rear film electrodes and its impact on performance.

articleTitle: New methods for video data pre-processing to improve the quality of computer vision systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Subject of study. A method of assessing changes in video data brightness that appear in a vision system under effect of external disturbance, and algorithms stabilizing the received video stream parameters are proposed. An assessment of video data quality as the result of data preliminary processing is given. Work objective is to create a methodology of objective analysis for the principal parameters variability in input data of video surveillance systems under negative factors influence and to develop effective algorithms to stabilize the parameters of the received video stream; it is also practical to evaluate the preprocessing quality and check the reliability of the proposed method on real video records. Tasks: when analyzing video recordings or real time video, determine the most universal, stable and informative quality indicator required for objective assessment of the video data quality under various shooting conditions and scene illumination features. It is also necessary to develop and implement programmatically algorithms for stabilizing video parameters. Methods used. Statistical analysis and treatment for the parameters of the analyzed video sequence as a random spatio-temporal process; algorithms to process video data with methods of digital filtering and adaptive stabilization of video stream brightness parameters. End results. It has been shown that the steadiest indicator of video stream quality is the average frame brightness (AFB). A universal algorithm for video data spatio-temporal processing of is proposed that forms the AFB values sequence from the original video stream; algorithms for filtering and stabilizing the brightness of a video stream are also given. Conclusions. Scientific novelty of the results obtained: A new method of objective analysis and parameters evaluation for the initial video surveillance data, and algorithms for filtering and stabilizing the video stream brightness are proposed. The performance of the proposed algorithms has been verified on real video surveillance data. The proposed algorithms are implemented in the Python software environment with using the OpenCV library functions.

articleTitle: Electricity Demand Management as a Supplement to Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Today, the energy industry is undergoing a radical transformation, the main engine of which is technological innovations, which provide opportunities for the transition to a fundamentally new stage of development. In recent years, there have been changes that forced a rethinking of the requirements for generation facilities, network infrastructure and, in general, the organization of the electricity industry and electricity markets. The increasing wear and tear of equipment, the involvement of distributed energy resources, the change in the role of traditional sources of energy and heat carriers, the growth of demand for electricity and the transformation of its quality characteristics, the change in the behavior of consumers - all this requires the study of the factors of the spread of new technologies in electricity for the transition to the next energy system. Therefore, the modern concept of the development of the electric power industry envisages increasing the active role of electricity consumers. The consumer moves away from the position of ⟨⟨passive⟩⟩ consumption and gets the opportunity to actively change his load with the help of his own (distributed) generation or demand management measures. The article analyzes the possibility of accounting for distributed generation and demand management when planning the development of electric power systems. The method of their joint examination with the help of a ⟨⟨virtual power plant⟩⟩ is described.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Part of the Mathematical Model for Simulating Processes in the Mechatronic System “Rotor in Active Magnetic Bearings”
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The paper considers an approach to the formation of an analytical mathematical model for simulating dynamic processes in a mechatronic system of a rotor in active magnetic bearings. Many industrial rotary machines can be reduced to such an electromechanical system, in which radial and axial controlled electromagnetic bearings are used as rotor supports. Traditionally, the processes in such active magnetic bearings are described in a simplified way as the dependence of the electromagnetic force on the current in the coil circuit and the rotor displacement, which does not take into account the dynamics of electromagnetic processes. The paper proposes a method for joint mathematical description of the dynamic behavior of a given mechatronic system. For this, the interrelated magnetomechanical equations of Lagrange-Maxwell are applied. Two forms of writing the electromagnetic part of this system of equations are considered using independent alternating currents and flux linkages in the coils of electromagnets with an analysis of the advantages of each of them. Based on the proposed method of the mathematical description, a simulation of the dynamic behavior of the rotor was performed, taking into account the dynamics of controlled electromagnetic processes in the circuits of active magnetic bearings for a large-scale laboratory model of a turbocompressor of a gas-pumping unit with two radial and one axial active magnetic bearings. The results of numerical analyzes are presented in the form of time dependences for rotor displacements and currents in circuits. Their comparison with experimental data allowed verifying the proposed method of the mathematical simulation. This method of the mathematical description of the electromagnetic part of the rotor system can be used for active magnetic bearings of various types and with different configurations of rotor and especially stator parts.

articleTitle: Risk Management Of The Startup Projects
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Startup projects are characterized by a high level of uncertainty and risk. Therefore, risk management is an important component of enabling their success. The risk of a startup project is defined as an objective and subjective category that reflects the probability of certain consequences (positive and/or negative) from the results of the team’s (group) actions of startup developers, their interaction, their decision-making abilities and problem-solving during the development process and implementation of a startup project in the conditions of uncertainty; influence of uncontrollable factors. The subjective and objective context of a startup project’s risks, and also the signs of risks in the process of development and implementation of a startup project, the differences of startup projects compared to projects of traditional businesses, which cause differences in risk management, are substantiated. The main stages of risk management are characterized by: 1) identification of a startup project’s risks. Risk identification methods and the importance of creating a register of potential risks are outlined; 2) risk assessment. The importance of using qualitative and quantitative methods of risk assessment of startup projects is indicated; 3) planning and decision-making on risk management, which include proposals and measures for prevention, avoidance, reduction, acceptance of risks; their implementation. The main decision-making models are outlined. The expedience of building a decision tree as an effective way to reach reasonable and optimal results in risk management of a startup project is described. The main aspects that will influence on the risk management trends of a startup projects in the future are identified.

articleTitle: Algorithmic Support for Building a Distributed IoT System in a Cloud Service
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) today already connects billions of different IoT devices with the Internet. With the advent of new services and services, new challenges arise: how to make a cloud service publicly available, and reliable, how and where to store data. The article considers an example of the implementation of an IoT application with cloud components, considers the implementation of connecting IoT components to a cloud provider, and presents the IoT architecture. The focus is on the architecture and implementation of data exchange protocols, the implementation of protocols? for data collection and management of remote system components Given the large amount of data transmitted by IoT devices to the cloud, data compression and interaction with cloud services is a very relevant topic. Therefore, the article also offers recommendations for managing the traffic of IoT devices. The purpose of this article is to provide a description and algorithm for connecting IoT devices to the cloud, to bring together disparate information, and make it open and understandable to beginners and academic researchers.

articleTitle: The uberization of the economy on the example of the electrical engineering domain and transport
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Uberization is a new trend in the economy which incorporates phone apps and other media into the activities of different entities, resulting in the introduction of a different way of purchasing or using an item or service. The term “uberization” has emerged in connection with popularisation of the Uber app and has been used in various areas of the economy: banking and finance, hospitality, medical services, as well as in the electrical engineering domain area and of transport. Uberization is a source of various benefits for entities which business model is no different or slightly different from Uber’s model. The operation of the entity, taking into account the assumptions of uberization, increases efficiency and reduces operating costs, especially during the COVID-19 period, and thus forces traditional entities to reorganize and change their business model. This leads to so-called creative destruction in the market, based on innovation and competition with the best, but also on the elimination of entities that do not keep up with technological changes or those that implement the traditional business model (non-Internet) regardless of changes in the surrounding economic reality. The work has a theoretical and research character. The methods used in the paper are theoretical and empirical, including causal analysis, abstraction, generalisation, inference, statistical method, comparative case study method and critical analysis of the literature.

articleTitle: Ecosystem-based technology innovation management in the European renewable energy sector
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This paper investigates the emerging concept of ecosystem-based technology innovation management in the European renewable energy sector. By analyzing the interplay between actors within the ecosystem, the study aims to uncover the strategies employed by organizations to leverage ecosystem dynamics and drive technology innovation. The research objective is addressed through a multi-step approach that integrates qualitative methods, social network analysis (SNA), frequency analysis, and analytical analysis. The findings reveal the composition and dynamics of the European renewable energy innovation ecosystem, highlighting the significant role of key non-profit organizations (NPOs) and multinational enterprises (MNEs) in shaping technology innovation and collaboration. The study emphasizes the importance of collaboration and partnerships among MNEs and NPOs in driving technology innovation within the sector. Key MNEs are identified as focal actors, demonstrating higher levels of engagement and strategic positioning across multiple NPOs. The insights gained from this research have practical implications for organizations operating in the renewable energy sector, enabling them to strategically position themselves, foster collaborations, and drive technology innovation more effectively. Overall, this study provides a comprehensive understanding of ecosystem-based technology innovation management in the European renewable energy sector, contributing to the existing knowledge on sustainable innovation ecosystems

articleTitle: Parkinson’s Disease Detection Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: In order to come up with an efficient method for the discovery of Parkinson’s Disease (PD), various research papers were taken into consideration that are dependent on Parkinson’s Detection using various Machine Learning algorithm (MLA). Patients with Parkinson’s disease (PWP) have movement issues as well as communication impairments, making physical visits for medication and monitoring challenges. Early identification of Parkinson’s disease allows people to live a normal life. The global aging population has brought about an increased focus on the importance of early, remote, and accurate detection of Parkinson’s disease (PD). This paper utilized the various techniques of MLA and it was also observed that the suggested model is more effective and provides higher precision. Here, the research has been carried out on the biological voice data of 31 individuals among which 23 suffered from PD. The potential outcomes of the paper is based on the detection accuracy using six different classifiers of ML. The accuracy output includes Support Vector Machine (SVM) 85%, Decision Tree 85%, Logistic Regression 85%, Random Forest 85%, Gradient Boost 87% and XG Boost 85%. From the above findings we propmote the incorporation of machine learning methodologies into clinical decision-making processes to enhance the accuracy and systematization of Parkinson’s disease diagnosis.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model of Damping of UAV Oscillations in the Cargo Delivery Problem
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: Currently, the use of unmanned vehicles for the delivery of goods is becoming a trend in many areas of human activity. At the same time, it is necessary to solve the problem of the integrity of the cargo because of its possible fluctuations. The paper deals with the problem of delivering cargo attached to a 4-motor UAV on a rigid cable. A control system is needed to achieve the UAV equilibrium position that can compensate for significant mismatches in the XY coordinate plane. A combination of two control algorithms is proposed for solving this problem, one of which provides a given position in the horizontal plane at small mismatch angles and the second at large mismatch angles. The first controller uses the PID controller algorithm with the corresponding optimal setting of its parameters, and the second one uses the bang-bang control scheme. An additional controller is used to coordinate these controllers, which ensures their timely switching. Some simulation is also proposed.

articleTitle: Features Of Field Simulation Of Electromagnetic Processes Of The Trolley’s Busbars
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: A mathematical spatial model was created to analyze electromagnetic processes within the steel trolley of the busbars, focusing on the time formulation of the electromagnetic field distribution problem. To enhance computational efficiency and reduce both dimensionality and calculation time, we’ve introduced a two-dimensional, plane-parallel mathematical model in the frequency domain for studying the electromagnetic field distribution. In order to consider the nonlinearity of magnetic properties in steel trolleys, we suggest establishing an effective magnetization curve for the nonlinear two-dimensional electromagnetic field problem associated with the busbar. The verification results obtained, as indicated by the calculated voltage drop, substantiate the high precision of the calculations and the reliability of the results obtained. The error, in this case, remains within the range of 1.88% to 2.06% for the two-dimensional model in the frequency domain, in comparison to the spatial model in the time-dependent electromagnetic field formulation.

articleTitle: Procedural Generation of Vegetation Cover for Simulators of Special Purpose Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: The article considers the method of procedural generation of vegetation cover, taking into account various landscape parameters. The method allows you to create a multilevel vegetation model based on several plant species, take into account the geometry and surface parameters, the presence of natural and artificial obstacles, as well as introduce random deviations in the plants location and landscape parameters that imitate the influence of natural factors on the flora growth within the simulated landscape. Such techniques provide a virtual simulated environment that was reproduced from the real one, at an acceptable time and resource cost for the generation process. The proposed method can be used as part of a software for the simulation and training system of special purpose vehicle operators.

articleTitle: Express Technology of Electrochemical Etching of Gallium Arsenide for the Formation of Massive Island Pores
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 4th KhPI Week on Advanced Technology (KhPIWeek)
abstract: This study presents an express technology for the electrochemical etching of Gallium Arsenide (GaAs) to form massive island pores. The n-type GaAs (Ill) single crystal plates are processed with a short pulse of strong current followed by a lower current density stage. The method forms a porous layer with almost wholly removing the GaAs surface single-crystal layer in just 3.5 minutes. The success of the technology relies on the application of a two-stage electrochemical treatment process, which in turn can find practical use in the formation of textured semiconductor layers on an industrial scale for photovoltaic applications. The article presents the EDX results and observations on pore-shape formations.
